children.text: dhūpācamanīyadīpanaivedyādīṃśca mūlena pradhānenopari pūjanaṃ pavitrīkaraṇamityuktam // LiP_2,24.32 //
children.translated_text: Incense, sipping-water, lamp, food-offering, etc. — with the root-mantra as the principal [one], worship above [the liṅga] and consecration — thus it is taught. (LiP 2,24.32)

children.text: ārārtidīpādīṃścaiva dhenumudrāmudritāni kavacenāvaguṇṭhināni ṣaṣṭhena rakṣitāni liṅge ca liṅgasyādhaḥ sādhāraṇaṃ ca darśayet // LiP_2,24.33 //
children.translated_text: The <s>ārārti</s>-lamp etc. — sealed with the cow-<s>mudrā</s>, veiled with the armor[-mantra], protected with the sixth [mantra] — one should show [these] to the <s>liṅga</s> and below the <s>liṅga</s> as the general [offering]. (LiP 2,24.33)

With the root-mantra offering salutation, declaring [the rites of] invocation, establishment, confinement, presence, <s>pādya</s>, sipping-water, <s>arghya</s>, sandal, flowers, incense, food-offering, sipping-water, mirror, lip-fragrance and other accessories — one should worship by the method of the <s>Brahmāṅga</s> enjoyment-path. (LiP 2,24.34)
The <s>sakala</s>-meditation, the <s>niṣkala</s>-remembrance, the <s>parāvara</s>-meditation, the root-mantra recitation;

children.text: daśāṃśaṃ brahmāṅgajapasamarpaṇamātmanivedanastutinamaskārādayaśca gurupūjā ca pūrvano dakṣiṇe vināyakasya // LiP_2,24.35 //
children.translated_text: one-tenth [additional recitation of] the <s>Brahmāṅga</s>-mantra, offering, self-dedication, praise, salutations, and guru-worship; on the south first, [worship] of <s>Vināyaka</s> [Gaṇeśa]. (LiP 2,24.35)

children.text: ādau cānte ca saṃpūjyo vighneśo jagadīśvaraḥ /
children.translated_text: At the beginning and at the end, <s>Vighneśa</s> [Gaṇeśa], Lord of the World, should be worshipped,
by gods and twice-born ones, for the accomplishment of all purposes in all rites. (LiP 2,24.36)

children.text: yaḥ śivaṃ pūjayedevaṃ liṅge vā sthāṇḍilepi vā /
children.translated_text: Whoever thus worships <s>Śiva</s> the god, whether in the <s>liṅga</s> or on a [consecrated] platform,

children.text: sa yāti śivasāyujyaṃ varṣamātreṇa karmaṇā // LiP_2,24.37 //
children.translated_text: he attains union with <s>Śiva</s> (<s>śivasāyujya</s>) by [merely] one year's practice. (LiP 2,24.37)
A worshipper of the <s>liṅga</s> [attains this] in six months — no deliberation is needed here.
Having performed seven circumambulations, the wise one should prostrate like a stick. (LiP 2,24.38)
By circumambulation in the proper direction, [one obtains] the fruit of a hundred horse-sacrifices (<s>asvamedha</s>).
Therefore, one should always worship for the accomplishment of all aims. (LiP 2.24.39)
One desiring enjoyment obtains enjoyment; one desiring kingship obtains kingship.

children.text: putrārthī tanayaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ rogī rogātpramucyate // LiP_2,24.40 //
children.translated_text: One desiring a son [obtains] an excellent son; one afflicted by disease is freed from disease. (LiP 2.24.40)
Whatever desires a person contemplates, those he obtains. (LiP 2.24.41)
Thus ends the twenty-fourth chapter in the <s>Uttarabhaga</s> of the glorious <s>Linga Mahapurana</s>.
<s>Sailadi</s> [<s>Nandin</s>] said:
I shall describe the fire-rites of <s>Siva</s> (<s>Sivagnikaryam</s>), as expounded by <s>Siva</s>.

children.text: janayitvāgrataḥ prācīṃ śubhe deśe susaṃskṛte // LiP_2,25.1 //
children.translated_text: Having first established the eastern [direction], in an auspicious, well-consecrated place, (LiP 2.25.1)
one should make three auspicious threads — with east-facing tip and north-facing tip.
In the field made quadrilateral, one should carefully make the fire-pits (<s>kunda</s>). (LiP 2.25.2)
The fire-pit for daily oblation (<s>nityahoma</s>), endowed with three girdles (<s>mekhala</s>) —
the girdles of four, three, and two <s>angulas</s> in breadth, [the pit being] one <s>hasta</s> (cubit) in measure. (LiP 2.25.3)
The fire-pit should be one <s>hasta</s>; the spout (<s>yoni</s>) should be one <s>pradesa</s> (span) in measure.
One should fashion the spout like an <s>asvattha</s> (pipal) leaf, above the girdle. (LiP 2.25.4)
In the middle of the pit, there should be a navel (<s>nabhi</s>), with eight petals and a pericarp (<s>karnika</s>),
one <s>pradesa</s> in measure, according to rule — [thus] one should have it made, O son of <s>Brahma</s>. (LiP 2.25.5)
The marking (<s>ullekhana</s>) is declared [to be done] with the sixth [mantra]; sprinkling (<s>proksana</s>) with the armor (<s>varman</s>) [mantra].

children.text: netreṇālokya vai kuṇḍaṃ ṣaḍrekhāḥ kārayedbudhaḥ // LiP_2,25.6 //
children.translated_text: Having inspected the pit with the eye [mantra], the wise one should make six lines. (LiP 2.25.6)
The east-facing lines [represent] <s>Brahma</s>, <s>Visnu</s>, and <s>Mahesvara</s>.

children.text: uttarāgrāḥ śivā rekhāḥ prokṣayedvarmaṇā punaḥ // LiP_2,25.7 //
children.translated_text: The north-facing auspicious lines — one should sprinkle again with the armor [mantra]. (LiP 2.25.7)
The fire-churning stick (<s>arani</s>), born from <s>sami</s> and <s>pippala</s> [trees], sixteen <s>angulas</s> [in length] —

children.text: mathitvā vahnibījena śaktinyāsaṃ hṛdaiva tu // LiP_2,25.8 //
children.translated_text: having churned with the fire-seed [mantra], placing <s>sakti</s> in the heart [of the fire], (LiP 2.25.8)
one should cast [the fire] according to rule, having mentally installed [it] as prescribed.

children.text: tūṣṇīṃ prādeśamātraistu yājñikaiḥ śakalaiḥ śubhaiḥ // LiP_2,25.9 //
children.translated_text: Silently, with sacrificial chips of one <s>pradesa</s> measure, auspicious, (LiP 2.25.9)
one should perform the <s>parisammodhana</s> (enchantment/soothing) with water in the eight directions.
One should strew [grass] according to rule, from the east onward in sequence: (LiP 2.25.10)
north-tipped in the east, east-tipped in the south,

children.text: paścime cottarāgraṃ tu saumye pūrvāgrameva tu // LiP_2,25.11 //
children.translated_text: north-tipped in the west, and east-tipped in the north. (LiP 2.25.11)
In the <s>Aindra</s> (eastern) [quarter], having invoked with <s>Aindra</s>-tipped [grass]; in the <s>Yamya</s> (southern), similarly it is prescribed.
Above the northern [quarter], the moon-fire tip; below, the <s>Varuna</s>-fire tip. (LiP 2.25.12)
The vessels, in pairs, [placed] upon the <s>barhis</s> (grass), O virtuous one —

children.text: adhomukhāni sarvāṇi dravyāṇi ca tathottare // LiP_2,25.13 //
children.translated_text: all with faces downward, and the substances to the north. (LiP 2.25.13)
Upon those, one should place <s>darbha</s> grass; <s>Siva</s> should be placed to the south.
One should worship with the root-mantra (<s>mulamantra</s>), and afterward perform the oblation (<s>homa</s>). (LiP 2.25.14)
Taking the sprinkling vessel (<s>proksani</s>-patra), one should fill it again with water.
Two <s>kusa</s> [blades] of one <s>pradesa</s> measure should be placed upon the water. (LiP 2.25.15)

children.text: plāvayecca kuśāgraṃ tu vasoḥ sūryasya raśmibhiḥ /
children.translated_text: One should drench the tips of the <s>kusa</s> with the rays of the Sun of <s>Vasu</s>.
Having scattered [water on] all the vessels, thoroughly sprinkling according to rule, (LiP 2.25.16)
taking the <s>pranita</s>-vessel, one should fill it again with water.
Having properly covered it with other water-tips of <s>kusa</s>, O virtuous one, (LiP 2.25.17)
with [both] hands, the nose-[shaped] vessel should be placed in the northeastern (<s>Aisanya</s>) direction.
The ghee-heating (<s>ajyadhisrayana</s>) should be performed to the northwest, auspiciously. (LiP 2.25.18)
Coals mixed with ash should be taken up with the <s>sakala</s> [mantra].

children.text: paścimottarato nītvā tatra cājyaṃ pratāpayet // LiP_2,25.19 //
children.translated_text: Having brought [them] to the northwest, there one should heat the ghee. (LiP 2.25.19)
Having ignited <s>kusa</s> in the fire, one should perform the circumambulation of fire (<s>paryagni</s>) three times.

children.text: tānsarvāṃstatra niḥkṣipya cāgre cājyaṃ nidhāpayet // LiP_2,25.20 //
children.translated_text: Casting all those [<s>kusa</s>] in there, one should then place the ghee in front. (LiP 2.25.20)

children.text: aṅguṣṭhamātrau tu kuśau prakṣālya vidhinaiva tu /
children.translated_text: Two <s>kusa</s> blades of thumb-measure, having washed according to rule,

children.text: paryagniṃ ca tataḥ kuryāttaireva navabhiḥ punaḥ // LiP_2,25.21 //
children.translated_text: one should then perform the fire-circumambulation again with those same nine [blades]. (LiP 2.25.21)
One should perform the fire-circumambulation again and then lower the ghee.
Then one should remove the vessel in sequence to the northwest. (LiP 2.25.22)
Having joined [it] with fire using a stick, washing and placing [it] to the west,
one should perform the purification (<s>utpavana</s>) of the ghee with the two purifiers (<s>pavitra</s>). (LiP 2.25.23)
Taking separately with [both] hands, in the forward direction in sequence,
with the thumb and ring finger, both, with the root-<s>vidya</s> (mantra), (LiP 2.25.24)
having sprinkled, one should place the two purifiers, smeared with ghee, into the fire.
The ladle (<s>sruk</s>) and spoon (<s>sruva</s>) should be made of gold, one <s>aratni</s> (cubit) in measure, O virtuous one. (LiP 2.25.25)
Or of silver, according to propriety, endowed with all [proper] characteristics.

children.text: athavā yājñikairvṛkṣaiḥ kartavyau sruksruvā vubhau // LiP_2,25.26 //
children.translated_text: Or else, both ladle and spoon should be made from sacrificial woods. (LiP 2.25.26)
One <s>aratni</s> in length — in its bowl (<s>potra</s>), the hole should be
six <s>angulas</s> in circumference at the base of the handle, O great sage. (LiP 2.25.27)
Half that for the neck-stem; the lotus [bowl] should be like the base.
The handle like a cow's tail; the tip of the spoon like a nose. (LiP 2.25.28)
Endowed with two cups, filled with pearls and the like,
thirty-six <s>angulas</s> in length, eight <s>angulas</s> in breadth, (LiP 2.25.29)
the height should be half that; then measured with a thread.
The face should be seven <s>angulas</s>, in breadth and length again. (LiP 2.25.30)
One-third should be the tip; having made [it], the remainder is discarded.

children.text: kaṇṭhaṃ ca dvyaṅgulāyāmaṃ vistāraṃ caturaṅgulam // LiP_2,25.31 //
children.translated_text: The neck, two <s>angulas</s> in length, four <s>angulas</s> in breadth. (LiP 2.25.31)
The altar (<s>vedi</s>), eight <s>angulas</s> in length, the breadth of that same measure.
In its middle, one should make a hole of four <s>angulas</s> in measure. (LiP 2.25.32)
The hole should be well-rounded, with eight petals and a fine pericarp.

children.text: parito bilabāhye tu paṭṭikārdhāṅgulena tu // LiP_2,25.33 //
children.translated_text: Around the hole's exterior, a border (<s>pattika</s>) of half an <s>angula</s>. (LiP 2.25.33)
In that <s>Brahma</s>-[section], an indentation decorated with lotus petals.
In that <s>Brahma</s>-[section], the border should be the measure of two barley grains. (LiP 2.25.34)
From the middle of the altar, a channel of the measure of the little finger,

children.text: khātaṃ yāvanmukhāntaḥ syādbilamānaṃ tu nimragam // LiP_2,25.35 //
children.translated_text: excavated as far as the inner mouth — the hole-measure being inward-going. (LiP 2.25.35)
The handle six <s>angulas</s>, the stem, three knobs at the handle's tip,
increasing by half an <s>angula</s>, to be made four <s>angulas</s>. (LiP 2.25.36)
Thirteen <s>angulas</s> in length, a pot (<s>ghata</s>) at the handle's base.
The jar (<s>kumbha</s>) should be two <s>angulas</s>; the navel should be known as ten <s>angulas</s>. (LiP 2.25.37)

children.text: vedimadhye tathā kṛtvā pādaṃ kuryācca dvyaṅgulam /
children.translated_text: Having thus made [it] in the middle of the altar, one should make a foot of two <s>angulas</s>,
the foot shaped like the back of a lotus, with the form of a pericarp. (LiP 2.25.38)
Its back should have the shape of an elephant's lip.
For <s>abhicara</s> (hostile rites) and the like, one should make [them] of black iron. (LiP 2.25.39)
With twenty-five <s>kusa</s> [blades], one should again clean the ladle and spoon,

children.text: agramagreṇa saṃśodhya madhyaṃ madhyena suvrata // LiP_2,25.40 //
children.translated_text: purifying the tip with the tip, the middle with the middle, O virtuous one, (LiP 2.25.40)

children.text: mūlaṃ mūlena vidhinā agnau tāpya hṛdā punaḥ /
children.translated_text: and the base with the base, according to rule; having heated [them] in the fire with the heart [mantra].

children.text: ājyasthālī praṇītā ca prokṣaṇī tisra eva ca // LiP_2,25.41 //
children.translated_text: The ghee-vessel, the <s>pranita</s>, and the sprinkling vessel — these three (LiP 2.25.41)

children.text: sauvarṇī rājatī vāpi tāmrī vā mṛnmayī tu vā /
children.translated_text: should be of gold, or silver, or copper, or of clay.

children.text: anyathā naiva kartavyaṃ śāntike pauṣṭike śubhe // LiP_2,25.42 //
children.translated_text: Otherwise, they should not be made [of other materials] — for pacifying (<s>santika</s>) and nourishing (<s>paustika</s>) rites, auspicious. (LiP 2.25.42)

children.text: āyasī tvabhicāre tu śāntike mṛnmayī tu vā /
children.translated_text: Of iron for hostile rites (<s>abhicara</s>); of clay for pacifying rites.
Six <s>angulas</s> wide — this is declared the mouth-measure of the vessels. (LiP 2.25.43)
The sprinkling vessel, two <s>angulas</s> in height; the <s>pranita</s>, two <s>angulas</s> more;
the ghee-vessel, its height two <s>angulas</s> more than that. (LiP 2.25.44)
With whatever fuel-sticks the oblation is declared, with those same the enclosing logs (<s>paridhi</s>) should be.
Of middle-finger circumference, unbent, unwounded, even, (LiP 2.25.45)
thirty-two <s>angulas</s> in length — three enclosing logs are prescribed.
With thirty <s>darbha</s> [blades] of thirty-two <s>angulas</s> in length, one should strew [the area]. (LiP 2.25.46)
Tied at the four-<s>angula</s> middle, clockwise.
For hostile rites (<s>abhicara</s>) and the like, the establishment of <s>Siva</s>-fire is excluded. (LiP 2.25.47)
Not soft, firm, O <s>brahmana</s> — these are to be collected for hostile rites.
Complete, well-proportioned, thick, of the measure of the little finger, (LiP 2.25.48)
unbent, unwounded, smooth, twelve <s>angulas</s> in measure —

children.text: samidhasthaṃ pramāṇaṃ hi sarvakāryeṣu suvrata // LiP_2,25.49 //
children.translated_text: this is the standard measure of fuel-sticks for all rites, O virtuous one. (LiP 2.25.49)

children.text: gavyaṃ ghṛtaṃ tataḥ śreṣṭha kāpilaṃ tu tato 'dhikam /
children.translated_text: Cow's ghee is the best; that of a tawny (<s>kapila</s>) cow is even superior.

children.text: āhutīnāṃ gramaṇaṃ tu mruvaṃ pūrṇaṃ yathā bhavet // LiP_2,25.50 //
children.translated_text: The measure of oblations — the spoon (<s>sruva</s>) should be full. (LiP 2.25.50)
Rice should be the measure of an eye (<s>aksa</s>); sesame the measure of a shell (<s>sukti</s>);

children.text: yavānāṃ ca tadardhaṃ syātphalānāṃ svapramāṇataḥ // LiP_2,25.51 //
children.translated_text: barley should be half of that; fruits according to their own measure. (LiP 2.25.51)
The measure of milk, honey, and curd should be like that of ghee.
With the measure of four spoons (<s>sruva</s>), with the ladle (<s>sruc</s>), the full oblation (<s>purnahuti</s>) should be. (LiP 2.25.52)
Half of that is declared for the <s>svistakrt</s> [offering]; the remainder, or all of it.

children.text: śāntikaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ caiva śivāgnau juhuyātsadā // LiP_2,25.53 //
children.translated_text: Pacifying (<s>santika</s>) and nourishing (<s>paustika</s>) [rites] should always be offered in the <s>Siva</s>-fire. (LiP 2.25.53)
In the ordinary (<s>laukika</s>) fire, O greatly fortunate one, [are performed] bewildering (<s>mohana</s>), banishing (<s>uccatana</s>), and the like.

children.text: śivāgniṃ janayitvā tu sarvakarmāṇe suvrata // LiP_2,25.54 //
children.translated_text: Having kindled the <s>Siva</s>-fire, for all rites, O virtuous one, (LiP 2.25.54)
one should invoke the seven tongues [of fire] and have all rites performed.
Or else, all rites are accomplished through the tongue [of fire] alone. (LiP 2.25.55)
'<s>Sivagni</s>' [is the name], O best of twice-born — the practitioner [works] through the tongue alone. (LiP 2.25.56)

children.text: oṃ bahurūpāyai madhyajihvāyai anekavarṇāyai dakṣiṇottaramadhyagāyai śāntipauṣṭikamokṣādiphalapradāyai svāhā // LiP_2,25.57 //
children.translated_text: Om, to Her of many forms, the middle tongue, of many colors, pervading south, north, and middle, granting the fruits of peace, prosperity, liberation, and the like — <s>Svaha</s>! (LiP 2.25.57)

children.text: oṃ hiraṇyāyai cāmīkarābhāyai īśānajihvāyai jñānapradāyai svāhā // LiP_2,25.58 //
children.translated_text: Om, to the Golden One, of gold-like luster, the <s>Isana</s> tongue, granting knowledge — <s>Svaha</s>! (LiP 2.25.58)

children.text: oṃ kanakāyai kanakanibhāyai ramyāyai eendrajihvāyai svāhā // LiP_2,25.59 //
children.translated_text: Om, to the Golden One, gold-resembling, the Lovely One, the <s>Indra</s> tongue — <s>Svaha</s>! (LiP 2.25.59)

children.text: oṃ raktāyai raktavarṇāyai āgneyajihvāyai anekavarṇāyai vidveṣaṇamohanāyai svāhā // LiP_2,25.60 //
children.translated_text: Om, to the Red One, of red color, the <s>Agneya</s> (fiery) tongue, of many colors, for causing enmity and bewilderment — <s>Svaha</s>! (LiP 2.25.60)

children.text: oṃ kṛṣṇāyai nairṛtajihvāyai māraṇāyai svāhā // LiP_2,25.61 //
children.translated_text: Om, to the Black One, the <s>Nairrta</s> (southwestern) tongue, for killing — <s>Svaha</s>! (LiP 2.25.61)

children.text: oṃ suprabhāyaipaścimajihvāyai muktāphalāyai śāntikāyai pauṣṭikāyai svāhā // LiP_2,25.62 //
children.translated_text: Om, to the Resplendent One, the western tongue, pearl-like, for pacification and nourishment — <s>Svaha</s>! (LiP 2.25.62)

children.text: oṃ abhivyaktāyai vāyavyajihvāyai śatrūccāṭanāyai svāhā // LiP_2,25.63 //
children.translated_text: Om, to the Manifest One, the <s>Vayavya</s> (northwestern) tongue, for banishing enemies — <s>Svaha</s>! (LiP 2.25.63)
Om, to <s>Vahni</s> (Fire), the Radiant One — <s>Svaha</s>! (LiP 2.25.64)
This much constitutes the fire-consecration (<s>vahnisaṃskara</s>); or else, in fire-rites,

children.text: naimittike ca vidhinā śivāgniṃ kārayetpunaḥ // LiP_2,25.65 //
children.translated_text: on special occasions (<s>naimittika</s>), according to rule, one should kindle the <s>Siva</s>-fire again. (LiP 2.25.65)

children.text: nirīkṣaṇaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ tāḍanaṃ ca ṣaṣṭhena phaḍantena abhyukṣaṇaṃ caturthena khananotkiraṇaṃ ṣaṣṭhena pūraṇaṃ samīkaraṇamādyena secanaṃ vauṣaḍantena kṛṭṭanaṃ ṣaṣṭhena saṃmārjanopalepane turīyeṇa kuṇḍaparikalpanaṃ nivṛttyā tribhireva kuṇḍaparidhānaṃ caturthena kuṇḍārcanamādyena rekhācatuṣṭayasapādanaṃ ṣaṣṭhena phaḍantena vajrīkaraṇaṃ catuṣpadāpādanamādyena evaṃ kuṇḍasaṃskāramaṣṭādaśavidham // LiP_2,25.66 //
children.translated_text: Inspection with the sixth [mantra with] <s>phat</s> ending; sprinkling and striking; aspersion with the fourth [mantra]; excavation and scattering with the sixth; filling and leveling with the first [mantra]; pouring with the <s>vausat</s>-ending [mantra]; cutting with the sixth; sweeping and plastering with the fourth; pit-preparation with three <s>nivrtti</s> [mantras]; pit-enclosing with the fourth; pit-worship with the first; establishing the four lines with the sixth <s>phat</s>-ending [mantra]; diamond-making; establishing the four feet with the first — thus the eighteen-fold pit-consecration (<s>kundasamskara</s>). (LiP 2.25.66)

After pit-consecration, the casting of the eye (<s>aksapatana</s>) with the sixth [mantra]; the placing of the grass-seat with the first; the invocation of <s>Vagisvarī</s> (Goddess of Speech) on the diamond-seat. (LiP 2.25.67)

children.text: oṃ hrīṃ vāgīśvarīṃ śyāmavarṇāṃ viśālākṣīṃ yauvanonmattavigrahām /
children.translated_text: Om <s>Hrim</s>, I invoke <s>Vagisvarī</s>, of dark complexion, wide-eyed, with a body intoxicated with youth,
in her menstrual season, the <s>Sakti</s> of <s>Vagīsvara</s> (Lord of Speech). (LiP 2.25.68)
I worship <s>Vagisvarī</s>. (LiP 2.25.69)
Om <s>Im</s>, salutation to <s>Vagīsvara</s>.

Having honored <s>Vagisvarī</s> with invocation, establishment, proximate-presence, sealing, and worship, [one performs] the embryo-establishment fire-consecration (<s>garbhadhana-vahnisaṃskara</s>). (LiP 2.25.70)

children.text: ekavaktraṃ caturbhujaṃ śuddhasphaṭikābhaṃ varadābhayahastaṃ paraśumṛgadharaṃ jaṭāmukuṭamaṇḍitaṃ sarvābharaṇabhūṣitamāvāhayāmi // LiP_2,25.71 //
children.translated_text: One-faced, four-armed, resembling pure crystal, with hands in the gesture of boon-granting and fearlessness, bearing an axe and a deer, adorned with a crown of matted locks, embellished with all ornaments — I invoke [<s>Vāgīśvara</s>]. (LiP 2,25.71)
'<s>Roṃ Iṃ Vāgīśvarāya Namaḥ</s>' —
Having honored <s>Vāgīśvarī</s> [with the rites of] invocation, establishment, bringing near, and confinement, ending with worship, [one performs] the <s>garbhādhāna</s>-fire sacrament. (LiP 2,25.72)

children.text: araṇījanitaṃ kāntodbhavaṃvā agnihotrajaṃvā tāmrapātreśarāvevā ānīya nirīkṣaṇatāḍanābhyukṣaṇaprakṣālanamādyenakravyādāśivaparityāgopi prathamena vahnestraikāraṇaṃ jaṭharabhrūmadyādāvāhyagniṃ vaikāraṇamūrtāvāgneyena uddīpanamādyena puraṣeṇa saṃhitayā dhāraṇā dhenumudrāṃ turīyeṇāvaguṇṭhya jānubhyāmavaniṃ gatvā śarāvotthāpanaṃ kuṇḍopari nidhāya pradakṣiṇamāvartya turīyeṇātmasammukhāṃ vāgīśvarīṃ garbhanāḍyāṃ garbhādhānāntarīyeṇa kamalapradānamādyena vauṣaḍantena kuśārghyaṃ dattvā indhanapradānamādyena prajvālanaṃ garbhādhānaṃ casadyenādyena pūjanaṃ vāmena pūjanaṃ dvitīyena sīmantonnayanamaghoreṇatṛtīyena pūjanam // LiP_2,25.73 //
children.translated_text: Fire produced from the fire-sticks (<s>araṇī</s>), or born from a magnet, or from the <s>agnihotra</s> — having brought it in a copper vessel or earthen dish — the inspection, striking, sprinkling, and washing with the first [mantra]; the abandoning of the corpse-eating, inauspicious [aspect of fire]; with the first [mantra] the three-fold causation of fire; having invoked fire from the belly, brow-center and such into the embodied form, with the <s>Āgneya</s> [mantra] the kindling; with the first [<s>Puruṣa</s> mantra] the <s>Saṃhitā</s> retention; showing the <s>dhenu-mudrā</s>; covering with the fourth [mantra]; going to the ground on one's knees; lifting the earthen dish and placing it upon the fire-pit; circumambulating; with the fourth [mantra], [turning] <s>Vāgīśvarī</s> to face oneself; through the embryonic channel, the <s>garbhādhāna</s> [rite]; with the secondary [mantra], the offering of a lotus; with the first [mantra] ending in <s>vauṣaṭ</s>, having given the <s>kuśa</s>-grass <s>arghya</s>; with the first [mantra], the offering of fuel and the kindling — [this is] the <s>garbhādhāna</s>. And with <s>Sadya</s> [<s>Sadyojāta</s>], the first [mantra], worship; with <s>Vāma</s> [<s>Vāmadeva</s>], worship; with the second, the parting-of-the-hair ceremony (<s>sīmantonnayana</s>); with <s>Aghora</s>, the third, worship. (LiP 2,25.73)

children.text: avayavavyāptiktrodanaṃ vaktraniṣkṛtiriti tṛtīyena garbhajātakarmapuruṣeṇa pūjanaṃ turīyema ṣaṣṭhena prokṣaṇaṃ sūtakaśuddhaye cāgnisūnurakṣākusāstreṇa vaktreṇāgnau mūlamīsāgraṃ nairṛtimūlaṃ vāyavyāgraṃ vāyavyamūlamīśāgramiti kuśāstaramamitipūrvoktamidhmamagramūlaghṛtāktaṃ lālāpanodāya ṣaṣṭhena juhuyāt // LiP_2,25.74 //
children.translated_text: The pervading of the limbs, the extraction from the mouth — with the third [mantra], the birth-ceremony of the embryo (<s>garbha-jātakarma</s>); with <s>Puruṣa</s>, worship; with the fourth, the sixth-day sprinkling for purification of birth-impurity; and the fire's son [i.e., the sacrificial grass] as protection with the weapon-mantra. In the fire, with the mouth [mantra], [placing kuśa grass:] root toward the northeast, tip toward the southwest; root toward the northwest, tip toward the northeast; root toward the northeast, tip toward [the opposite] — this is the kuśa-weapon arrangement as previously described. The fuel-stick with tip and root anointed with ghee, for removal of drooling — one should offer with the sixth [mantra]. (LiP 2,25.74)

children.text: pañcapūrvātikrameṇa paridhiviṣṭaranyāso 'pi ādyena viṣṭaropari hiraṇyagarbhaharanārāyaṇānapi pūjayet // LiP_2,25.75 //
children.translated_text: By the sequence of the five preceding [mantras], the placement of the enclosing sticks (<s>paridhi</s>) and the grass-seat (<s>viṣṭara</s>); and with the first [mantra], upon the grass-seat, one should also worship <s>Hiraṇyagarbha</s>, <s>Hara</s>, and <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>. (LiP 2,25.75)
One should worship <s>Indra</s> and the other world-guardians (<s>lokapālas</s>). (LiP 2,25.76)
One should worship [the deities] up to <s>Vajrāvarta</s>. (LiP 2,25.77)
Having dismissed [with the first mantra] the worship of <s>Vāgīśvara</s> and <s>Vāgīśvarī</s>, one should release the offering into the fire. (LiP 2,25.78)

children.text: sraksruvasaṃskāramatho nirīkṣaṇaprokṣamatāḍanābhyukṣaṇādīni pūrvavat srak sruvaṃ ca hastadvaye gṛhītvā saṃsthāpanamādyena tāḍanamapi sruksruvopari darbhānulekhanamūlamadyamāgreṇa tritvena srakśākti sruvamapi śaṃbhuṃ dakṣiṇapārśve kuśopari śaktaye namaḥ śaṃbhave namaḥ // LiP_2,25.79 //
children.translated_text: The consecration of the ladle (<s>sruk</s>) and spoon (<s>sruva</s>): inspection, sprinkling, striking, and washing as before. Having taken the <s>sruk</s> and <s>sruva</s> in both hands, establishment with the first [mantra]; striking also; tracing [three lines] with <s>darbha</s> grass on the <s>sruk</s> and <s>sruva</s> — root, middle, and tip — threefold. The <s>sruk</s> is <s>Śakti</s>; the <s>sruva</s> is <s>Śambhu</s>. On the right side, upon <s>kuśa</s> grass — '<s>Śaktaye Namaḥ</s>, <s>Śambhave Namaḥ</s>.' (LiP 2,25.79)

children.text: tato hyantisūtreṇa sruksruvau turīyema veṣṭayedarcayecca // LiP_2,25.80 //
children.translated_text: Then with the binding-thread (<s>anti-sūtra</s>), one should wrap the <s>sruk</s> and <s>sruva</s> with the fourth [mantra] and worship. (LiP 2,25.80)

children.text: dhenumudrāṃ darśāyitvā turīyeṇāvaguṇṭhya ṣaṣṭhena rakṣāṃ vidhāya sruksruvasaṃskāraḥ pūrvamevoktaḥ // LiP_2,25.81 //
children.translated_text: Having shown the <s>dhenu-mudrā</s>, covering with the fourth [mantra], performing protection with the sixth [mantra] — the consecration of the <s>sruk</s> and <s>sruva</s> has been described as before. (LiP 2,25.81)
Again, the consecration of the ghee — as described before: inspection, sprinkling, striking, and washing as before. (LiP 2,25.82)

children.text: ājyapratāpanamaiśānyāṃ vā ṣaṣṭhena vedyupari vinyasya ghṛtapātraṃ vitastimātraṃ kuśapavitraṃ vāmahastāṅguṣṭhānāmikāgraṃ gṛhītvā dakṣiṇāṅguṣṭhānāmikāmūlaṃ gṛhītvāgnijvālotpavanaṃ svāhāntena turīyeṇa punaḥ ṣaḍ darbhān gṛhītvā pūrvavatsvātmasaṃplavanaṃ svahāntenādyena kuśadvayapavitrabandhanaṃ cādyenaghṛte nyasediti pavitrīkaraṇam // LiP_2,25.83 //
children.translated_text: Heating the ghee in the northeast, or having placed the ghee-vessel upon the altar with the sixth [mantra], [the vessel being] a span in measure; taking the <s>kuśa</s>-purifier with the tip of the left thumb and ring finger, grasping the base of the right thumb and ring finger; fanning of the fire-flame — with the fourth [mantra] ending in <s>svāhā</s>. Again, taking six <s>darbha</s> grasses, self-immersion as before ending in <s>svāhā</s>; with the first [mantra], tying the purifier of two <s>kuśa</s> grasses; and with the first [mantra], placing [it] in the ghee — this is the purification (<s>pavitrīkaraṇa</s>). (LiP 2,25.83)
Taking two <s>darbha</s> grasses and kindling the fire, one should turn the ghee three times;
having sprinkled [it], one should place [it] in the fire — this is the <s>nīrājana</s> (lustration). (LiP 2,25.84)

children.text: punardarbhān gṛhītvā kīṭakādi nirīkṣyārghyeṇa saṃprokṣya darbhānagnau nidhāya ityavadyotanam // LiP_2,25.85 //
children.translated_text: Again, taking <s>darbha</s> grasses, having inspected for insects and such, sprinkling with the <s>arghya</s>-water, placing the <s>darbha</s> grasses in the fire — this is the <s>avadyotana</s> (illumination). (LiP 2,25.85)
Taking two <s>darbha</s> grasses, one should inspect the ghee by the fire-flame. (LiP 2,25.86)

children.text: darbheṇa gṛhītvā tenāgradvayena śuklapakṣadvayenādyeneti kṛṣṇapakṣasaṃpātanaṃ ghṛtaṃ tribhāgena vibhajya sruveṇaikabhāgenājyenāgnayesvāhā dvitīyenājyena somāya svāhā ājyena oṃ agnīṣomābhyāṃ svāhā ājyenāgnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā // LiP_2,25.87 //
children.translated_text: Having taken [the ghee] with a <s>darbha</s>, with both tips, with the two bright fortnights, with the first [mantra] — this is the casting-off of the dark fortnight. Dividing the ghee into three parts with the <s>sruva</s>: with one part of ghee — '<s>Agnaye Svāhā</s>'; with the second part of ghee — '<s>Somāya Svāhā</s>'; with ghee — '<s>Oṃ Agnīṣomābhyāṃ Svāhā</s>'; with ghee — '<s>Agnaye Sviṣṭakṛte Svāhā</s>.' (LiP 2,25.87)

children.text: punaḥ kuśena gṛhītvā saṃhitābhimantreṇa namontenābhimantrayet // LiP_2,25.88 //
children.translated_text: Again, having taken [it] with <s>kuśa</s> grass, one should consecrate with the <s>Saṃhitā</s> mantra ending in <s>namaḥ</s>. (LiP 2,25.88)
Having consecrated, showing the <s>dhenu-mudrā</s>, covering with the armor [mantra], performing protection with the weapon [mantra] —
then one should place [it] in the consecrated [vessel]. [This is] the consecration of the ghee. (LiP 2,25.89)
With ghee, with the deer-faced [ladle], the circular anointing (<s>cakrābhighāraṇa</s>) — '<s>Śaktibījād Īśānamūrtaye Svāhā</s>';

children.text: pūrvavatpuruṣavattrāya svāhā aghorahṛdayāyasvāhā vāmadevāya guhyāya svāhā sadyojātamūrtaye svāhā /
children.translated_text: 'to <s>Puruṣa</s>-face, <s>Svāhā</s>'; 'to <s>Aghora</s>-heart, <s>Svāhā</s>'; 'to <s>Vāmadeva</s>, to the secret one, <s>Svāhā</s>'; 'to <s>Sadyojāta</s>-form, <s>Svāhā</s>' —
this is the opening of the mouths (<s>vaktrodghāṭana</s>). (LiP 2,25.90)

children.text: īśānamūrtaye tatpuruṣavaktrāya svāhā tatpuruṣavaktrāya aghorahṛdayāya svāhā aghorahṛdayāya vāmaguhyāya sadyojatamūrtaye svāhā iti vaktrasaṃdhānam // LiP_2,25.91 //
children.translated_text: 'To <s>Īśāna</s>-form, to <s>Tatpuruṣa</s>-face, <s>Svāhā</s>'; 'to <s>Tatpuruṣa</s>-face, to <s>Aghora</s>-heart, <s>Svāhā</s>'; 'to <s>Aghora</s>-heart, to <s>Vāma</s>-secret, to <s>Sadyojāta</s>-form, <s>Svāhā</s>' — this is the joining of the mouths (<s>vaktrasaṃdhāna</s>). (LiP 2,25.91)

children.text: īśānamūrtaye tatpuruṣāya vaktrāya aghorahṛdayāya vāmadevāya guhyā sadyojātāya svāhā iti vaktrasaṃdhānam // LiP_2,25.91 //
children.translated_text: 'To <s>Īśāna</s>-form, to <s>Tatpuruṣa</s>, to the face, to <s>Aghora</s>-heart, to <s>Vāmadeva</s>, to the secret one, to <s>Sadyojāta</s>, <s>Svāhā</s>' — this is the joining of the mouths (<s>vaktrasaṃdhāna</s>). (LiP 2,25.91)

children.text: īśānamūrtaye tatpuruṣāya vaktrāya aghorahṛdayāya vāmadevāya guhyāya sadyojātamūrtaye svāhā iti vaktraikyakaraṇam // LiP_2,25.92 //
children.translated_text: 'To <s>Īśāna</s>-form, to <s>Tatpuruṣa</s>, to the face, to <s>Aghora</s>-heart, to <s>Vāmadeva</s>, to the secret one, to <s>Sadyojāta</s>-form, <s>Svāhā</s>' — this is the unification of the mouths (<s>vaktraikyakaraṇa</s>). (LiP 2,25.92)
Having thus generated the <s>Śiva</s>-fire, one should perform all rites,

children.text: kevalaṃ jihvayā vāpi śāntikādyāni sarvadā // LiP_2,25.93 //
children.translated_text: with the tongue [of fire] alone — <s>śānti</s> (peace rites) and others, always. (LiP 2,25.93)
In rites such as <s>garbhādhāna</s> and others, for each fire, O imperishable one,

children.text: daśa āhutāyo deyā yonibījena pañcadhā // LiP_2,25.94 //
children.translated_text: ten oblations should be given, with the <s>yonibīja</s> (seed-syllable of the womb) fivefold. (LiP 2,25.94)
In the <s>Śiva</s>-fire, one should establish the divine, supreme seat as before,

children.text: āvāhanaṃ tathā nyāsaṃ yathā deve tathārcanam // LiP_2,25.95 //
children.translated_text: with invocation and <s>nyāsa</s> (placement), worship as for the God [Himself]. (LiP 2,25.95)
Having recited the root mantra once, having bowed to the God of Gods,
having performed the threefold <s>prāṇāyāma</s> with the <s>garbha</s> [seed-syllables], approved by all, (LiP 2,25.96)
preceded by the sprinkling (<s>paripecana</s>), and having anointed the fuel-stick,
one should offer [it] into the midst of the blazing fire, O great sage. (LiP 2,25.97)
Having also made the two preliminary ghee-pourings (<s>āghāra</s>) with ghee alone, O six-faced one,

children.text: ājyabhāgau tu juhuyādvidhinaiva ghṛtena ca // LiP_2,25.98 //
children.translated_text: one should offer the two ghee-portions (<s>ājyabhāga</s>) according to the rule with ghee. (LiP 2,25.98)

children.text: cakṣuṣī cājyabhāgau tu cāgnaye ca tathottare /
children.translated_text: The two eyes [of the fire] are the two ghee-portions — to <s>Agni</s> on the northern [side],

children.text: ātmano dakṣiṇe caiva somāyeti dvijottama // LiP_2,25.99 //
children.translated_text: and on one's southern [side] to <s>Soma</s>, O best of twice-born. (LiP 2,25.99)
Of the west-facing God, the <s>Śiva</s>-fire, O son of <s>Brahmā</s>,

children.text: akṣi vai dakṣiṇaṃ caiva cottaraṃ cottaraṃ tathā // LiP_2,25.100 //
children.translated_text: the right eye is indeed [the southern], and the northern is the northern. (LiP 2,25.100)

children.text: dakṣiṇaṃ tu mahābhāga bhavatyeva na saṃśayaḥ /
children.translated_text: The southern one, O greatly fortunate one, becomes [the right eye] — there is no doubt.
The oblations with ghee there [are offered] with the root mantra alone, ten [times]. (LiP 2,25.101)

children.text: caruṇā ca yathāvaddhi samidbhiśca tathā smṛtam /
children.translated_text: With the oblation (<s>caru</s>) properly, and with fuel-sticks likewise, it is prescribed.
Then one should give the full oblation (<s>pūrṇāhuti</s>) with the root mantra, O one of good vows. (LiP 2,25.102)
To all the encircling deities, five by five as before,
in the order beginning with <s>Īśāna</s>, and in the order of the <s>Śakti</s>-seed-syllables. (LiP 2,25.103)
The expiation (<s>prāyaścitta</s>) with the <s>Aghora</s> [mantra], ending with one's desired [deity], as prescribed before.
The threefold fire-rite has been described by me, supremely beautiful. (LiP 2,25.104)
According to the occasion, one should always perform thus, O great sage.
At the end of life, one attains heaven; one attains the fire-offering [reward]. (LiP 2,25.105)

children.text: narakaṃ caiva nāpnoti yasya kasyāpi karmaṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: One does not reach hell from any action [if one performs this].
A practitioner desiring liberation should perform the <s>homa</s> without harm to any being. (LiP 2,25.106)
One should contemplate the fire as situated in the heart, and offer through the sacrifice of meditation,
to <s>Śiva</s>, situated in the bodies of all beings, the Lord of all the worlds. (LiP 2,25.107)
Having known Him, one should offer with devotion through <s>prāṇāyāma</s>, constantly.

children.text: bāhyahomapradātā tu pāṣāṇe darduro bhavet // LiP_2,25.108 //
children.translated_text: One who merely offers external <s>homa</s> becomes a frog on a stone. (LiP 2,25.108)
Thus ends the twenty-fifth chapter of the <s>Uttarabhāga</s> of the glorious <s>Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa</s>.
<s>Śailādi</s> said:
Alternatively, one should worship the God <s>Īśāna</s>, <s>Śiva</s>, in the <s>liṅga</s> —
a Brahmin devoted to <s>Śiva</s>, intent on meditation upon <s>Śiva</s>. (LiP 2,26.1)
Having taken ash born from the <s>agnihotra</s> [with the mantra] '<s>Agni</s>' and so forth,
one should dust all limbs [with ash], from the soles of the feet to the crown of the head. (LiP 2,26.2)
One should sip water through the <s>brahmatīrtha</s> (base of the thumb), wearing the sacred thread, facing north.

children.text: athoṃnamaḥ śivāyeti tanuṃ kṛtvātmanaḥ punaḥ // LiP_2,26.3 //
children.translated_text: Then [reciting] '<s>Oṃ Namaḥ Śivāya</s>,' having made one's body [pure], again — (LiP 2,26.3)

children.text: devaṃ ca tena mantreṇa pūjayetpraṇavena ca /
children.translated_text: one should worship the God with that mantra and with <s>Praṇava</s> (Oṃ).
The worship of <s>Aghoreśa</s>, the trident-bearer, is superior to all [other worship]. (LiP 2,26.4)
The general worship, the entire fire-rite, O one of good vows,
differs [only] in the mantras of that Lord — being the meditation on <s>Aghora</s>. (LiP 2,26.5)

children.text: aghorebhyo 'tha ghorebhyo ghoraghoratarebhyaḥ śarvebhyaḥ sarvaśarvebhyo namaste astu rudrarūpebhyaḥ // LiP_2,26.6 //
children.translated_text: 'Salutation to the non-terrible ones (<s>Aghora</s>), and to the terrible ones (<s>Ghora</s>), to the most terrible of the terrible, to all the <s>Śarvas</s>, to every <s>Śarva</s> — salutation be to you, O ones of <s>Rudra</s>-form.' (LiP 2,26.6)
The mantra:

children.text:
aghorebhyaḥ praśāntahṛdayāya namaḥ /
atha ghorebhyaḥ sarvātmabrahmaśirase svāhā /
ghoraghoratarebhyaḥ jvālāmālinī śikāyai vaṣaṭ /
sarvebhyaḥ sarvaśarvebhyaḥ piṅgalakavacāya hum /

children.translated_text: 'Salutation be to you, O ones of <s>Rudra</s>-form — <s>Vaṣaṭ</s> to the three eyes.'
'To the thousand-eyed, the impenetrable — <s>Huṃ Phaṭ</s> to the <s>Pāśupata</s> weapon.'
Having bathed, sipped water, made one's body [pure], sprinkled, [performed] the <s>aghamarṣaṇa</s> (sin-destroying [mantra]),

children.text: tarpaṇaṃ vidhinā cārghyaṃ bhānave bhānupūjanam // LiP_2,26.7 //
children.translated_text: libation (<s>tarpana</s>) according to rites, and <s>arghya</s> to the sun — the sun-worship. (LiP 2,26.7)

'To the non-terrible ones — salutation to the one of peaceful heart.' / 'And to the terrible ones — <s>Svāhā</s> to the head of the self of all, <s>Brahman</s>.' / 'To the most terrible of the terrible — <s>Vaṣaṭ</s> to the crest, <s>Jvālāmālinī</s> (garland of flames).' / 'To all the <s>Śarvas</s>, to every <s>Śarva</s> — <s>Hum</s> to the tawny armor.'
The same as the <s>Aghora</s> worship, differentiated by mantra alone.

children.text: mārgaśuddhistathā dvāri pūjāṃ vāstvadhipasya ca // LiP_2,26.8 //
children.translated_text: Purification of the path, and worship at the door of the master of the dwelling — (LiP 2,26.8)
having done this, having first purified the hands, assuming a pure seat,
having placed [the attention] on the lotus at the tip of the nose, with eyes consumed by the fire of <s>kṣubhikā</s> — (LiP 2,26.9)

children.text: vāyunā prerya tadbhasma viśodhya ca śubhāṃ bhasā /
children.translated_text: driving [impurities] with the wind, [burning] that ash, purifying with the auspicious light (<s>bhās</s>),
through <s>Śakti</s>, in the nectar-made <s>Brahma</s>-<s>kalā</s>, one should establish it there. (LiP 2,26.10)
Making <s>Aghora</s> fivefold, accompanied by the five limb-[mantras],

children.text: itthaṃ jñānākriyāmevaṃ vinyasya ca vidhānataḥ // LiP_2,26.11 //
children.translated_text: having thus arranged the knowledge-and-action [aspects] according to the rule, (LiP 2,26.11)
with the <s>nyāsa</s> accompanied by the three eyes, having meditated in the heart on the supreme seat,

children.text: nābhau vahnigataṃ smṛtvā bhrūmadhye dīpavatprabhum // LiP_2,26.12 //
children.translated_text: contemplating [<s>Śiva</s>] as situated in fire at the navel, like a lamp between the eyebrows — the Lord — (LiP 2,26.12)
with <s>Śānti</s> [kalā], endowed with seed-syllables, sprouts, infinite <s>dharma</s> and such,
endowed with moon, sun, and fire, accompanied by the three forms, (LiP 2,26.13)
accompanied by <s>Vāmā</s> and others, presided over by <s>Manonmanī</s>,
seated on <s>Śiva</s>'s seat, of imperishable form, of the self-form — (LiP 2,26.14)
<s>Śiva</s>, whose body consists of thirty-eight <s>kalās</s>, endowed with the three principles,
the God with eighteen arms, wearing an elephant-skin as upper garment, (LiP 2,26.15)
wearing a lion-skin as lower garment — <s>Aghora</s>, the Supreme Lord,
in the form of thirty-two syllables, surrounded by thirty-two <s>Śaktis</s>, (LiP 2,26.16)
endowed with all ornaments, saluted by all gods,
adorned with a garland of skulls, a scorpion-ornament on the forehead, (LiP 2,26.17)
with a face [bright] as the full moon, gentle, equal in radiance to ten million moons,
bearing a crescent moon, accompanied by <s>Śakti</s>, of dark-blue form, (LiP 2,26.18)

children.text: haste khaḍgaṃ kheṭakaṃ pāśamekeratnaiścitraṃ cāṅkuśaṃ nāgakakṣām /
children.translated_text: in [His] hands: a sword, a shield, a noose on one [side], a goad studded with gems, a serpent-girdle,

children.text: śarasanaṃ pāśupataṃ tathāstraṃ daṇḍaṃ ca khaṭvāṅgamathāpare ca // LiP_2,26.19 //
children.translated_text: a bow, the <s>Pāśupata</s> weapon, a staff, and a skull-topped staff (<s>khaṭvāṅga</s>), and in the other [hands], (LiP 2,26.19)

children.text: tantrīṃ ca ghaṇṭāṃ vipulaṃ ca śūlaṃ tathāpare ḍāmarukaṃ ca divyam /
children.translated_text: a lute-string, a bell, a great trident, and also the divine <s>ḍamaru</s> (drum) —

children.text: vajraṃ gadāṃ ṭaṅkamekaṃ ca dīptaṃ samudraraṃ hastamathāsya śaṃbhoḥ // LiP_2,26.20 //
children.translated_text: A thunderbolt, a mace, and a single blazing battle-axe — [these are] the hands of <s>Śambhu</s>. (LiP 2,26.20)
With the boon-granting and fear-removing hands, [one should meditate on] the most excellent Supreme Lord.

children.text: bhāvayetpūjayeccāpi vahnau homaṃ ca kārayet // LiP_2,26.21 //
children.translated_text: One should meditate on and worship [Him], and also perform oblation in the fire. (LiP 2,26.21)
The oblation is entirely as before; the differentiation of mantras has been described.
The eight flowers, fragrance, and the like — the worship, praise, and food-offering; (LiP 2,26.22)
the inner offering (<s>antarbali</s>) of the fire-pit, with the fire [mantra], according to the rule.
Having made the <s>maṇḍala</s> according to the rule, with these mantras in proper sequence — (LiP 2,26.23)

children.text: rudrebhyo mātṛgaṇebhyo yakṣebhyo 'surebhyo grahebhyo rākṣasebhyo nāgebhyo nakṣatrebhyo viśvagaṇebhyaḥ kṣetrapālebhyaḥ atha vāyuvaruṇadigbhāge kṣetrapālabaliṃ kṣipet /
children.translated_text: [offerings] to the <s>Rudras</s>, to the hosts of Mothers, to the <s>Yakṣas</s>, to the <s>Asuras</s>, to the planets, to the <s>Rākṣasas</s>, to the <s>Nāgas</s>, to the <s>Nakṣatras</s>, to the hosts of the <s>Viśvedevas</s>, to the field-guardians — then in the wind-<s>Varuṇa</s> directional quarter, one should cast the field-guardian offering.

children.text: arghyaṃ gandhaṃ ca puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ dīpaṃ ca suvratāḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Arghya</s> (water-offering), fragrance, flowers, incense, and lamp, O ones of good vows,

children.text: naivedyaṃ mukhavāsādi nivedyaṃ vai yathāvidhi // LiP_2,26.24 //
children.translated_text: food-offering, mouth-freshener, and the like — should be presented according to the rule. (LiP 2,26.24)
Having thus informed [the deities] and dismissed them, worship with the eight flowers.
This is the general [procedure] common to all worship, O bulls among sages. (LiP 2,26.25)
Thus has been briefly stated the <s>Aghora</s> worship and the rest, O one of good vows.

children.text: aghorārcāvidhānaṃ ca liṅgevā sthāṇḍile 'pi vā // LiP_2,26.26 //
children.translated_text: The rule of <s>Aghora</s> worship [applies] whether on a <s>liṅga</s> or on a platform (<s>sthaṇḍila</s>). (LiP 2,26.26)
Worship on the <s>liṅga</s> is a crore times [more meritorious] than on a platform — the supreme [worship].
A brahmin devoted to <s>liṅga</s> worship, even by sins arising from great transgressions, (LiP 2,26.27)
is not stained — like a lotus petal by water.

children.text: liṅgasya darśanaṃ puṇyaṃ darśanātsparśanaṃ varam // LiP_2,26.28 //
children.translated_text: The sight of the <s>liṅga</s> is meritorious; touching is superior to seeing; (LiP 2,26.28)
there is nothing greater than worship, O son of <s>Brahmā</s>, without doubt.
Thus has been briefly stated the supreme <s>Aghora</s> worship. (LiP 2,26.29)
Even in a hundred crore years, it cannot be [fully described] in detail. (LiP 2,26.30)
Thus ends the twenty-sixth chapter of the <s>Uttarabhāga</s> of the glorious <s>Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa</s>.
The sages said:
The glory of <s>Nandin</s> and the fruit of <s>liṅga</s>-worship have been heard,

children.text: śrutibhiḥ saṃmitaṃ sarvaṃ romaharṣaṇa suvrata // LiP_2,27.1 //
children.translated_text: all in accordance with the <s>śrutis</s>, O <s>Lomaharṣaṇa</s>, O one of good vows. (LiP 2,27.1)
The victory-consecration (<s>jayābhiṣeka</s>) was formerly told by the Lord to <s>Manu</s>,
on the peak of <s>Meru</s>, for the benefit of <s>kṣatriyas</s>, by the trident-bearer. (LiP 2,27.2)
Tell us of the sixteen types of great gifts, and the splendid [rites],
O <s>Sūta</s>, O best of the wise — you are able to tell us. (LiP 2,27.3)
<s>Sūta</s> said:

children.text: jīvacchrāddhaṃ purā kṛtvā manuḥ svāyaṃbhuvaḥ prabhuḥ /
children.translated_text: Having formerly performed the <s>jīvacchrāddha</s> (śrāddha while living), <s>Manu Svāyambhuva</s>, the Lord,
going to <s>Meru</s>, praised the God of Gods, <s>Nīlalohita</s> (the Blue-Red one). (LiP 2,27.4)

children.text: tapasā ca vinītāya prahṛṣṭaḥ pradadau bhavaḥ /
children.translated_text: Pleased by his austerity, <s>Bhava</s> graciously granted

children.text: divyaṃ darśanamīśānas tenāpaśyat tam avyayam // LiP_2,27.5 //
children.translated_text: divine vision to <s>Īśāna</s>; with that [vision], he beheld the Imperishable One. (LiP 2,27.5)
Having bowed, worshipped according to the rule, he stood with palms joined.
'The God has been worshipped and seen by me now.
What was previously told to <s>Śakra</s> (<s>Indra</s>), bestowing <s>dharma</s>, <s>kāma</s>, <s>artha</s>, and <s>mokṣa</s> — (LiP 2,27.6)
O God of Gods, O Lord of the universe, salutation to you, O Lord of the worlds!
The <s>jīvacchrāddha</s>, O <s>Mahādeva</s>, has been fashioned by your grace. (LiP 2,27.7)

children.text: pūjitaś ca tato devo dṛṣṭaś caiva mayādhunā /
children.translated_text: The God has been worshipped and seen by me now.
What was previously told to <s>Śakra</s>, bestowing <s>dharma</s>, <s>kāma</s>, <s>artha</s>, and <s>mokṣa</s> — (LiP 2,27.8)
please tell me the victory-consecration, O God of Gods, O Lord!'
<s>Sūta</s> said:
To him, the god <s>Mahādeva</s>, the blessed <s>Nīlalohita</s>, (LiP 2,27.9)
the Supreme Lord, told the complete victory-consecration.
The Blessed Lord said:
'I shall describe the victory-consecration, for the benefit of kings, (LiP 2,27.10)
for conquering untimely death and for victory over all enemies.
When the time of battle arrives, having performed this consecration, (LiP 2,27.11)
and having consecrated one's lord, one should go to fight on the battlefield.

children.text: vidhinā maṇḍapaṃ kṛtvā prapāṃvā kūṭameva vā // LiP_2,27.12 //
children.translated_text: Having constructed a pavilion according to the rule, either a shelter or a canopy, (LiP 2,27.12)
a brahmin versed in the <s>Vedas</s> should establish nine fires.

children.text: tataḥ sarvābhiṣekārthaṃ sūtrapātaṃ ca kārayet // LiP_2,27.13 //
children.translated_text: Then, for the purpose of the complete consecration, he should cause the cord-laying to be done. (LiP 2,27.13)
The color-thread [laid] from east to [west], and likewise from south [to north],

children.text: sahasrāṇāṃ dvayaṃ tatra śatānāṃ ca catuṣṭayam // LiP_2,27.14 //
children.translated_text: two thousand and four hundred [positions] therein. (LiP 2,27.14)

children.text: śeṣameva subhaṃ koṣṭhaṃ teṣu koṣṭhaṃ tu saṃharet /
children.translated_text: The remaining auspicious cells — among those cells one should consolidate.
In the outer lane, one square on each side, one should consolidate all around. (LiP 2,27.15)
Gathering the limb-cords according to the rule, each separately,

children.text: prāgādyaṃ varṇasūtraṃ ca dakṣiṇādyaṃ tathā punaḥ // LiP_2,27.16 //
children.translated_text: the color-thread from east, and likewise from south — (LiP 2,27.16)
from east and from south, one should consolidate thirty-six in sequence.

children.text: prāgādyāḥ paṅktayaḥ sapta dakṣiṇādyāstathā punaḥ // LiP_2,27.17 //
children.translated_text: Seven rows from the east, and likewise from the south — (LiP 2,27.17)
therefore, forty-nine rows are proclaimed.
Nine rows should be removed from the middle, with water [mixed with] sandalwood and cow-dung. (LiP 2,27.18)
A lotus should be drawn there, beautiful, the size of a hand-span,
with eight petals, white, circular, with pericarp and filaments. (LiP 2,27.19)
The pericarp, eight <s>aṅgulas</s> in size, resembling gold;
the filament area is said to be four <s>aṅgulas</s> in measure. (LiP 2,27.20)

children.text: dharmo jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ ca yathākramam /
children.translated_text: <s>Dharma</s>, knowledge (<s>jñāna</s>), dispassion (<s>vairāgya</s>), and lordship (<s>aiśvarya</s>), in proper order,
should be placed in the corners beginning with the southeast, with <s>praṇava</s>. (LiP 2,27.21)

children.text: avyaktādīni vai dikṣu gātrākāreṇa vai nyaset /
children.translated_text: The Unmanifest and the like should be placed in the cardinal directions, in the form of limbs.

children.text: avyaktaṃ niyataḥ kālaḥ kālī ceti catuṣṭayam // LiP_2,27.22 //
children.translated_text: The Unmanifest, the Regulated, Time, and <s>Kālī</s> — [these are the] four. (LiP 2,27.22)
White, red, golden, and dark — [the colors of] <s>Dharma</s> and the rest, in order.

children.text: haṃsākāreṇa vai gātraṃ hemābhāsena suvratāḥ // LiP_2,27.23 //
children.translated_text: In the form of a swan, with golden radiance, O ones of good vows — (LiP 2,27.23)
in the midst of the supporting power (<s>ādhāraśakti</s>), the lotus, the cause of creation;
a single dot (<s>bindu</s>) in the midst of the <s>kalā</s>, and beyond that the form of <s>nāda</s> (sound). (LiP 2,27.24)
Above the <s>nāda</s>, one should meditate on <s>Śiva</s>, called <s>Oṃkāra</s>, the teacher of the world.

children.text: manonmanīṃ ca padmābhaṃmahādevaṃ ca bhāvayet // LiP_2,27.25 //
children.translated_text: One should also meditate on <s>Manonmanī</s> and <s>Mahādeva</s>, radiant as a lotus. (LiP 2,27.25)
<s>Vāmā</s> and the others, in order, should be [placed] in the filaments from the east.

children.text: vāmā jyeṣṭhā tathā raudrī kālī vikaraṇī tathā // LiP_2,27.26 //
children.translated_text: <s>Vāmā</s>, <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s>, <s>Raudrī</s>, <s>Kālī</s>, <s>Vikaraṇī</s>, (LiP 2,27.26)

children.text: balā pramathinī devī damanī ca yathāṅkramam /
children.translated_text: <s>Balā</s>, <s>Pramathinī</s>, the goddess <s>Damanī</s> — in proper sequence.
Together with <s>Vāmadeva</s> and the others, one should place [them] with <s>praṇava</s>. (LiP 2,27.27)

children.text: namo 'stu vāmadevāya namo jyeṣṭhāya śūline // LiP_2,27.28 //
children.translated_text: 'Salutation to <s>Vāmadeva</s>! Salutation to <s>Jyeṣṭhā</s>, to the Trident-bearer! (LiP 2,27.28)
To <s>Rudra</s>, to the one whose form is Time, and to <s>Kalāvikaraṇā</s>!

children.text: balāya ca tathā sarvabhūtasya damanāya ca // LiP_2,27.29 //
children.translated_text: To <s>Balā</s>, and to the Subduer of all beings! (LiP 2,27.29)
To the god <s>Manonmana</s>, and to <s>Manonmanī</s>, salutations!'
With these mantras, one should worship the surrounding circle as is proper. (LiP 2,27.30)
The first enclosure (<s>āvaraṇa</s>) has been described — now hear the second enclosure.

children.text: dvitīyāvaraṇe caiva śaktayaḥ ṣoḍaśaiva tu // LiP_2,27.31 //
children.translated_text: In the second enclosure, there are sixteen <s>śaktis</s> (powers). (LiP 2,27.31)
And in the third enclosure, twenty-four in sequence.

children.text: piśāca vīrthirvai madhye nābhivīthiḥ samantataḥ // LiP_2,27.32 //
children.translated_text: The <s>Piśāca</s> lane in the middle; the navel-lane all around. (LiP 2,27.32)
With these mantras, as is proper, the <s>Piśāca</s> [deities] are proclaimed.
One thousand and eight <s>padas</s> (positions), each with an eight-petaled [lotus]. (LiP 2,27.33)
In each of those positions, separately, a lotus in sequence
should be fashioned with rice, <s>vāra</s> (grain), wheat, barley, and the like, (LiP 2,27.34)
with unbroken rice, sesame seeds, and white mustard.
Alternatively, one should fashion [them] with these [grains], as appropriate to the season, according to the rule. (LiP 2,27.35)
One should draw eight petals in those [positions], with pericarp and filaments.

children.text: śālīnāmāḍhakaṃ proktaṃ kamalānāṃ pṛthak pṛthak // LiP_2,27.36 //
children.translated_text: One <s>āḍhaka</s> (measure) of rice is prescribed for each separate lotus. (LiP 2,27.36)
Half that of unbroken rice, and half of that for barley and the like.

children.text: droṇaṃ pradhānakuṃbhasya tadardhaṃ taṇḍulāḥ smṛtāḥ // LiP_2,27.37 //
children.translated_text: One <s>droṇa</s> (measure) for the principal vessel; half that is prescribed as rice. (LiP 2,27.37)
One <s>āḍhaka</s> of sesame in the middle; half that of barley.

children.text: athāṃbhasā samabhyukṣya kamalaṃ praṇavena tu // LiP_2,27.38 //
children.translated_text: Then, having sprinkled with water, [one should place] the lotus with <s>praṇava</s>. (LiP 2,27.38)
In all of those [positions], according to the rule, one should place <s>praṇava</s> in sequence.
Having thus completed and sprinkled, [for] the supreme one thousand <s>padas</s> — (LiP 2,27.39)

children.text: kalaśānāṃ sahasrāṇi haimāni ca śubhāni ca /
children.translated_text: a thousand vessels (<s>kalaśas</s>), golden and auspicious,
with the described characteristics, one should have made — or of silver, (LiP 2,27.40)
or of copper, as is proper, with <s>arghya</s>-water and <s>praṇava</s>.
The belly [of the vessel] is described as twelve <s>aṅgulas</s> wide; (LiP 2,27.41)
rounded, half that [at the base]; the navel is fashioned [accordingly].

children.text: kaṇṭhaṃ tu dvyaṅgulotsedhaṃ vistaraṃ caturaṅgulam // LiP_2,27.42 //
children.translated_text: The neck is two <s>aṅgulas</s> high and four <s>aṅgulas</s> wide. (LiP 2,27.42)
The lip is two <s>aṅgulas</s> high; the protrusion is said to be two <s>aṅgulas</s>.

children.text: tattadvai dviguṇaṃ divyaṃ śivakuṃbhe prakīrtitam // LiP_2,27.43 //
children.translated_text: All that doubled is proclaimed as divine, for the <s>Śiva</s>-vessel. (LiP 2,27.43)
With a barley-grain's gap, one should properly wrap with thread,
cover, sprinkle, and place <s>kuśa</s> grass on top, according to the rule. (LiP 2,27.44)
As before, with <s>praṇava</s>, one should fill with fragrant water.
One should establish the <s>Śiva</s>-vessel-laden offering-tray (<s>vardhanī</s>) according to the rule. (LiP 2,27.45)

children.text: madhyapadmāsya madhye tu sakūrcaṃ sākṣataṃ kramāt /
children.translated_text: In the middle of the central lotus, with <s>kuśa</s> grass and unbroken rice, in order,

children.text: āveṣṭya vastrayugmena pracchādya kamalena tu // LiP_2,27.46 //
children.translated_text: wrapped with a pair of cloths, covered with a lotus — (LiP 2,27.46)
golden, with variegated gems — the thousand vessels, separately.

children.text: śivakuṃbhe śivaṃ sthāpya gāyatryā praṇaveja ca // LiP_2,27.47 //
children.translated_text: Having established <s>Śiva</s> in the <s>Śiva</s>-vessel, with the <s>Gāyatrī</s> and <s>praṇava</s>: (LiP 2,27.47)
'We know the <s>Puruṣa</s>; we meditate on <s>Mahādeva</s>;
may <s>Rudra</s> inspire us.' (LiP 2,27.48)
By this mantra, the presence of <s>Rudra</s> is always established.

children.text: vardhanyāṃ devigāyatryā devīṃ saṃsthāpya pūjayet // LiP_2,27.49 //
children.translated_text: In the offering-tray, one should establish and worship the Goddess with the <s>Devī-Gāyatrī</s>: (LiP 2,27.49)
'We know <s>Gaṇāmbikā</s>; we meditate on the one of great austerity;
may <s>Gaurī</s> inspire us.' (LiP 2,27.50)
In the first enclosure, <s>Vāmā</s> and the others have been proclaimed.
The first enclosure has been described — now hear the second enclosure. (LiP 2,27.51)
Sixteen <s>śaktis</s> are here, in the positions from east onward, O one of good vows.

children.text: eendravyūhasya madhye tu subhadrāṃ sthāpya pūjayet // LiP_2,27.52 //
children.translated_text: In the middle of the <s>Indra</s> formation, one should establish and worship <s>Subhadrā</s>. (LiP 2,27.52)
<s>Bhadrā</s> in the southeast formation; <s>Kanakāṇḍajā</s> in the south;

children.text: aṃbikāṃ nairṛte vyūhe madhyakuṃbhe tu pūjayet // LiP_2,27.53 //
children.translated_text: <s>Ambikā</s> in the southwest formation — one should worship in the central vessel. (LiP 2,27.53)
<s>Śrīdevī</s> in the western quarter; <s>Vāgīśā</s> in the wind-quarter;

children.text: gomukhīṃ saumyabhāge tu madhyakuṃbhe tu pūjayet // LiP_2,27.54 //
children.translated_text: <s>Gomukhī</s> in the northern quarter — one should worship in the central vessel. (LiP 2,27.54)
In the middle of the <s>Rudra</s> formation, one should worship <s>Bhadrakarṇā</s>.
Between <s>Indra</s> and <s>Agni</s> directions, one should worship the auspicious <s>Aṇimā</s> (minuteness). (LiP 2,27.55)
Between south and southeast, one should place <s>Laghimā</s> (lightness) in the lotus.
Between <s>Rākṣasa</s> (southwest) and <s>Antaka</s> (south), one should worship <s>Mahimā</s> (greatness) in the center. (LiP 2,27.56)
Between <s>Varuṇa</s> (west) and <s>Asura</s> (southwest), one should worship <s>Prāpti</s> (attainment) in the center.
Between <s>Varuṇa</s> and <s>Anila</s> (northwest), one should place <s>Prākāmya</s> (irresistible will) in the lotus. (LiP 2,27.57)
Between <s>Vitteśa</s> (north) and <s>Anila</s>, one should establish and worship <s>Īśitva</s> (sovereignty).
Between <s>Vitteśa</s> and <s>Īśāna</s> (northeast), one should establish and worship <s>Vaśitva</s> (subjugation). (LiP 2,27.58)
Between <s>Indra</s> (east) and <s>Īśāna</s>, one should worship <s>Kāmāvasāyaka</s> (desire-fulfillment).
The second enclosure has been described — now hear the third enclosure. (LiP 2,27.59)
Twenty-four <s>śaktis</s> in the main vessels;
one should worship them in the midst of the formation, as before, according to the rule. (LiP 2,27.60)
<s>Dīkṣā</s>, <s>Dīkṣāyikā</s>, <s>Caṇḍā</s>, <s>Caṇḍāṃśunāyikā</s>,

children.text: sumatiṃ sumatyāyīṃ ca gopāṃ gopāyikāṃ tathā // LiP_2,27.61 //
children.translated_text: <s>Sumati</s>, <s>Sumatyāyī</s>, <s>Gopā</s>, <s>Gopāyikā</s>; (LiP 2,27.61)

children.text: atha nandaṃ ca nandāyīṃ pitāmahamataḥ param /
children.translated_text: then <s>Nanda</s>, <s>Nandāyī</s>, <s>Pitāmaha</s>, and beyond that,

children.text: pitāmahāyīṃ pūrvādyaṃ vidhinā sthāpya pūjayet // LiP_2,27.62 //
children.translated_text: <s>Pitāmahāyī</s> — from the east onward, one should establish and worship according to the rule. (LiP 2,27.62)
Having thus worshipped according to the rule, the third auspicious enclosure [is complete].
Having approached the <s>Saubhadra</s> array, in the first enclosure, in sequence — (LiP 2.27.63)
one should install [the deities] beginning from the east, according to the rite, the group of eight <s>Śaktis</s> in order.

children.text: dvitīyāvaraṇe caiva prāgādyaṃ śṛṇu śaktayaḥ // LiP_2,27.64 //
children.translated_text: And in the second enclosure, beginning from the east — hear the <s>Śaktis</s>: (LiP 2.27.64)

children.text: ṣoḍaśaiva tu abhyarcya padmamudrāṃ tu darśayet /
children.translated_text: Having worshipped sixteen indeed, one should display the lotus-<s>mudrā</s>.

children.text: bindukā bindugarbhā ca nādinī nādagarbhajā // LiP_2,27.65 //
children.translated_text: <s>Bindukā</s>, <s>Bindugarbhā</s>, <s>Nādinī</s>, <s>Nādagarbhajā</s>, (LiP 2.27.65)

children.text: śaktikā śaktigarbhā ca parā caiva parāparā /
children.translated_text: <s>Śaktikā</s>, <s>Śaktigarbhā</s>, <s>Parā</s>, and <s>Parāparā</s> —
in the first enclosure, eight <s>Śaktis</s> are declared. (LiP 2.27.66)
<s>Caṇḍā</s>, <s>Caṇḍamukhī</s>, <s>Caṇḍavegā</s>, <s>Manojavā</s>,
<s>Caṇḍākṣī</s>, <s>Caṇḍanirghoṣā</s>, <s>Bhṛkuṭī</s>, and <s>Caṇḍanāyikā</s>; (LiP 2.27.67)
<s>Manotsedhā</s>, <s>Manodhyakṣā</s>, <s>Mānasī</s>, <s>Mānanāyikā</s>,
<s>Manoharī</s>, <s>Manohlādī</s>, <s>Manaḥprīti</s>, and <s>Maheśvarī</s> — (LiP 2.27.68)
in the second enclosure, sixteen are declared.

children.text: saubhadraḥ kathito vyūho bhadraṃ vyūhaṃ śṛṇuṣva me // LiP_2,27.69 //
children.translated_text: The <s>Saubhadra</s> [array] has been described; hear from me the <s>Bhadra</s> array. (LiP 2.27.69)

children.text: eendrī hautāśanī yāmyā nairṛtī vāruṇī tathā /
children.translated_text: <s>Aindrī</s>, <s>Hautāśanī</s>, <s>Yāmyā</s>, <s>Nairṛtī</s>, <s>Vāruṇī</s>,

children.text: vāyavyā caiva kauberī aiśānī cāṣṭaśaktayaḥ // LiP_2,27.70 //
children.translated_text: <s>Vāyavyā</s>, <s>Kauberī</s>, and <s>Aiśānī</s> — the eight <s>Śaktis</s>. (LiP 2.27.70)
The first enclosure has been stated; hear the second enclosure.

children.text: hariṇā ca suvarṇā ca kāñcanī hāṭakī tathā // LiP_2,27.71 //
children.translated_text: <s>Hariṇā</s>, <s>Suvarṇā</s>, <s>Kāñcanī</s>, <s>Hāṭakī</s>, (LiP 2.27.71)
<s>Rukmiṇī</s>, <s>Satyabhāmā</s>, <s>Subhagā</s>, and <s>Jambunāyikā</s>;

children.text: vāgbhavā vākpathā vāṇī bhīmā citrarathā sudhīḥ // LiP_2,27.72 //
children.translated_text: <s>Vāgbhavā</s>, <s>Vākpathā</s>, <s>Vāṇī</s>, <s>Bhīmā</s>, <s>Citrarathā</s>, <s>Sudhī</s>, (LiP 2.27.72)
<s>Vedamātā</s>, and <s>Hiraṇyākṣī</s> — [these] are in the second enclosure.

children.text: bhadrākhyaḥ kathito vyūhaḥ kanakākhyaṃ śṛṇuṣva me // LiP_2,27.73 //
children.translated_text: The <s>Bhadra</s> array has been described; hear from me the <s>Kanaka</s> (golden) array. (LiP 2.27.73)

children.text: vajraṃ śaktiṃ ca daṇḍaṃ ca khaḍgaṃ pāśaṃ dhvajaṃ tathā /
children.translated_text: Thunderbolt, spear, staff, sword, noose, banner,

children.text: gadāṃ triśulaṃ kramaśaḥ prathamāvaraṇe smṛtāḥ // LiP_2,27.74 //
children.translated_text: mace, and trident — in sequence, [these are] in the first enclosure. (LiP 2.27.74)

children.text: yuddhā prabuddhā caṇḍā ca muṇḍā caiva kapālinī /
children.translated_text: <s>Yuddhā</s>, <s>Prabuddhā</s>, <s>Caṇḍā</s>, <s>Muṇḍā</s>, and <s>Kapālinī</s>;
<s>Mṛtyuhantrī</s>, <s>Virūpākṣī</s>, <s>Kapardā</s>, and <s>Kamalāsanā</s>; (LiP 2.27.75)
<s>Daṃṣṭriṇī</s>, <s>Raṅgiṇī</s>, <s>Lambākṣī</s>, and <s>Kaṅkabhūṣaṇī</s>;

children.text: saṃbhāvā bhāvinī caiva ṣoḍaśaiva prakīrtitāḥ // LiP_2,27.76 //
children.translated_text: <s>Saṃbhāvā</s> and <s>Bhāvinī</s> — sixteen are declared. (LiP 2.27.76)
The first array has been described; hear from me the <s>Ambikā</s> array.

children.text: khecarī cātmanā sā ca bhavānī vahnirūpiṇī // LiP_2,27.77 //
children.translated_text: <s>Khecarī</s> and she [who is] the Self, <s>Bhavānī</s>, of the form of fire, (LiP 2.27.77)
<s>Vahninī</s>, <s>Vahninābhā</s>, <s>Mahimā</s>, and <s>Amṛtalālasā</s> —
in the first enclosure, eight <s>Śaktis</s>, acknowledged by all. (LiP 2.27.78)

children.text: kṣamā ca śikharā devī ṛturatnā silā tathā /
children.translated_text: <s>Kṣamā</s>, <s>Śikharā Devī</s>, <s>Ṛturatnā</s>, <s>Silā</s>,

children.text: chāyā bhūtapanī dhanyā indramātā ca vaiṣṇavī // LiP_2,27.79 //
children.translated_text: <s>Chāyā</s>, <s>Bhūtapanī</s>, <s>Dhanyā</s>, <s>Indramātā</s>, and <s>Vaiṣṇavī</s>; (LiP 2.27.79)
<s>Tṛṣṇā</s>, <s>Rāgavatī</s>, <s>Mohā</s>, <s>Kāmakopā</s>, <s>Mahotkaṭā</s>,

children.text: indrā ca badhirā devī ṣoḍaśaitāḥ prakīrtitāḥ // LiP_2,27.80 //
children.translated_text: <s>Indrā</s>, and <s>Badhirā Devī</s> — these sixteen are declared. (LiP 2.27.80)
The <s>Āmbikā</s> array has been described; hear the <s>Śrī</s> array, O one of excellent vows.

children.text: svarśā svarśavatī gandhā prāṇāpānā samānikā // LiP_2,27.81 //
children.translated_text: <s>Svarśā</s>, <s>Svarśavatī</s>, <s>Gandhā</s>, <s>Prāṇāpānā</s>, <s>Samānikā</s>, (LiP 2.27.81)
<s>Udānā</s>, and [one] named <s>Vyāna</s> — [these] are in the first enclosure.

children.text: tamohatā prabhāmoghā tejinī dahinī tathā // LiP_2,27.82 //
children.translated_text: <s>Tamohatā</s>, <s>Prabhāmoghā</s>, <s>Tejinī</s>, <s>Dahinī</s>, (LiP 2.27.82)
<s>Bhīmāsyā</s>, <s>Jālinī</s>, <s>Coṣā</s>, <s>Śoṣiṇī</s>, <s>Rudranāyikā</s>,

children.text: varibhadrā gaṇādhyakṣā candrahāsā ca gahvarā // LiP_2,27.83 //
children.translated_text: <s>Varibhadrā</s>, <s>Gaṇādhyakṣā</s>, <s>Candrahāsā</s>, and <s>Gahvarā</s>, (LiP 2.27.83)
<s>Gaṇamātā</s>, and <s>Ambikā</s> — <s>Śaktis</s> acknowledged by all;
in the second enclosure, sixteen are declared in sequence. (LiP 2.27.84)
The <s>Śrī</s> array has been described; hear the <s>Vāgīśa</s> [array], O one of excellent vows.

children.text: dhārā vāridharā caiva vahnikī nāśakī tathā // LiP_2,27.85 //
children.translated_text: <s>Dhārā</s>, <s>Vāridharā</s>, <s>Vahnikī</s>, <s>Nāśakī</s>, (LiP 2.27.85)
<s>Martyātītā</s>, <s>Mahāmāyā</s>, <s>Vajriṇī</s>, and <s>Kāmadenukā</s> —
in the first enclosure too, eight <s>Śaktis</s> are thus declared. (LiP 2.27.86)

children.text: payoṣṇī vāruṇī śāntā jayantī ca varapradā /
children.translated_text: <s>Payoṣṇī</s>, <s>Vāruṇī</s>, <s>Śāntā</s>, <s>Jayantī</s>, and <s>Varapradā</s>;

children.text: plāvinī jalamātā ca payomātā mahāṃbikā // LiP_2,27.87 //
children.translated_text: <s>Plāvinī</s>, <s>Jalamātā</s>, <s>Payomātā</s>, and <s>Mahāmbikā</s>; (LiP 2.27.87)
<s>Raktā</s>, <s>Karālī</s>, <s>Caṇḍākṣī</s>, <s>Mahocchuṣmā</s>, <s>Payasvinī</s>,

children.text: māyā vidyeśvarī kālī kālikā ca yathākramam // LiP_2,27.88 //
children.translated_text: <s>Māyā</s>, <s>Vidyeśvarī</s>, <s>Kālī</s>, and <s>Kālikā</s> — in sequence. (LiP 2.27.88)
Sixteen are declared — <s>Śaktis</s> acknowledged by all.

children.text: vyūho vāgīśvaraḥ prokto gomukho vyūha ucyate // LiP_2,27.89 //
children.translated_text: The <s>Vāgīśvara</s> array has been declared; now the <s>Gomukha</s> (cow-faced) array is described. (LiP 2.27.89)

children.text: śaṅkīnī hālinī caiva laṅkāvarṇā ca kalkinī /
children.translated_text: <s>Śaṅkīnī</s>, <s>Hālinī</s>, <s>Laṅkāvarṇā</s>, and <s>Kalkinī</s>;

children.text: yakṣiṇī mālinī caiva vamanī ca rasātmanī // LiP_2,27.90 //
children.translated_text: <s>Yakṣiṇī</s>, <s>Mālinī</s>, <s>Vamanī</s>, and <s>Rasātmanī</s> — (LiP 2.27.90)
in the first enclosure, eight <s>Śaktis</s> are declared.

children.text: caṇḍā ghaṇṭā mahānādā sumukhī durmukhī balā // LiP_2,27.91 //
children.translated_text: <s>Caṇḍā</s>, <s>Ghaṇṭā</s>, <s>Mahānādā</s>, <s>Sumukhī</s>, <s>Durmukhī</s>, <s>Balā</s>, (LiP 2.27.91)

children.text: revatī prathamā ghorā sainyā līnā mahābalā /
children.translated_text: <s>Revatī</s>, <s>Prathamā</s>, <s>Ghorā</s>, <s>Sainyā</s>, <s>Līnā</s>, <s>Mahābalā</s>;

children.text: jayā ca vijayā caiva aparā cāparājitā // LiP_2,27.92 //
children.translated_text: <s>Jayā</s>, <s>Vijayā</s>, <s>Aparā</s>, and <s>Aparājitā</s> — (LiP 2.27.92)
in the second enclosure, sixteen <s>Śaktis</s> indeed.

children.text: kathito gomukhīvyūho bhadrakarṇī śṛṇuṣva me // LiP_2,27.93 //
children.translated_text: The <s>Gomukhī</s> array has been described; hear from me the <s>Bhadrakarṇī</s> [array]. (LiP 2.27.93)
<s>Mahājayā</s>, <s>Virūpākṣī</s>, <s>Śuklābhā</s>, and <s>Ākāśamātṛkā</s>;

children.text: saṃhāri jātahārī ca daṃṣṭrālī suṣkarevatī // LiP_2,27.94 //
children.translated_text: <s>Saṃhārī</s>, <s>Jātahārī</s>, <s>Daṃṣṭrālī</s>, and <s>Suṣkarevatī</s> — (LiP 2.27.94)
in the first enclosure, eight <s>Śaktis</s> are declared.
<s>Pipīlikā</s>, <s>Puṇyahārī</s>, <s>Aśanī</s>, and <s>Sarvahāriṇī</s>; (LiP 2.27.95)
<s>Bhadrahā</s>, <s>Viśvahārī</s>, <s>Himā</s>, and <s>Yogeśvarī</s>;

children.text: chidrā bhānumatī chidrā saiṃhikī surabhī samā // LiP_2,27.96 //
children.translated_text: <s>Chidrā</s>, <s>Bhānumatī</s>, <s>Chidrā</s>, <s>Saiṃhikī</s>, <s>Surabhī</s>, <s>Samā</s>, (LiP 2.27.96)

children.text: sarvabhavyā ca vegākhyā śaktayaḥ ṣoḍaśaiva tu /
children.translated_text: <s>Sarvabhavyā</s>, and <s>Vegā</s> by name — sixteen <s>Śaktis</s> indeed.
The eightfold great arrays have been declared; hear the eightfold sub-arrays. (LiP 2.27.97)
Having surrounded the <s>Aṇimā</s> (minuteness) array, in the first enclosure, in sequence:

children.text: eendrā tu citrabhānuśca vāruṇī daṇḍireva ca // LiP_2,27.98 //
children.translated_text: <s>Aindrā</s>, <s>Citrabhānu</s>, <s>Vāruṇī</s>, and <s>Daṇḍi</s>; (LiP 2.27.98)
<s>Prāṇarūpin</s>, <s>Haṃsa</s>, <s>Svātmaśakti</s>, and <s>Pitāmaha</s> —
the first enclosure has been stated; hear the second enclosure. (LiP 2.27.99)
<s>Keśava</s>, the blessed <s>Rudra</s>, the Moon, and the Sun;

children.text: mahātmā ca tathā hyātmā hyantarātmā maheśvaraḥ // LiP_2,27.100 //
children.translated_text: <s>Mahātmā</s> (the great soul), <s>Ātmā</s> (the self), <s>Antarātmā</s> (the inner self), and <s>Maheśvara</s>; (LiP 2.27.100)
<s>Paramātmā</s> (the supreme self), <s>Aṇu</s> (the atom), <s>Jīva</s> (the individual soul), <s>Piṅgala</s>, <s>Puruṣa</s>, <s>Paśu</s> (the bound soul),
<s>Bhoktā</s> (the enjoyer), <s>Bhūtapati</s> (lord of beings), and <s>Bhīma</s> — [these] are in the second enclosure. (LiP 2.27.101)
The <s>Aṇimā</s> array has been described; I shall tell you the <s>Laghimā</s> (lightness) [array].
<s>Śrīkaṇṭha</s>, <s>Anta</s>, <s>Sūkṣma</s>, <s>Trimūrti</s>, and <s>Śaśaka</s>; (LiP 2.27.102)
<s>Amareśa</s>, <s>Sthitīśa</s>, and <s>Dārata</s> as the eighth —
the first enclosure has been stated; hear the second enclosure. (LiP 2.27.103)
<s>Sthāṇu</s>, <s>Hara</s>, <s>Daṇḍeśa</s>, <s>Bhauktīśa</s>, and <s>Surapuṅgava</s>;
<s>Sadyojāta</s>, <s>Anugraheśa</s>, <s>Krūrasena</s>, and <s>Sureśvara</s>; (LiP 2.27.104)

children.text: krodhīśaśca tathā caṇḍaḥ pracaṇḍaḥ śiva eva ca /
children.translated_text: <s>Krodhīśa</s>, <s>Caṇḍa</s>, <s>Pracaṇḍa</s>, and <s>Śiva</s> himself;
<s>Ekarudra</s>, <s>Kūrma</s>, <s>Ekanetra</s>, and <s>Caturmukha</s> — (LiP 2.27.105)
in the second enclosure, sixteen <s>Rudras</s> are declared.
The <s>Laghimā</s> array has been described; hear the <s>Mahimā</s> (greatness) [array], O one of excellent vows. (LiP 2.27.106)
<s>Ajeśa</s>, <s>Kṣemarudra</s>, <s>Soma</s>, <s>Aṃśa</s>, <s>Lāṅgalī</s>,

children.text: daṇḍāruścārdhanārī ca ekāntaścānta eva ca // LiP_2,27.107 //
children.translated_text: <s>Daṇḍāru</s>, <s>Ardhanārī</s>, <s>Ekānta</s>, and <s>Anta</s> as well; (LiP 2.27.107)

children.text: pālī bhujaṅganāmā ca pinākī khaḍkireva ca /
children.translated_text: <s>Pālī</s>, <s>Bhujaṅga</s> by name, <s>Pinākī</s>, and <s>Khaḍgi</s>;

children.text: kāma īśastathā śveto bhṛguḥ ṣoḍaśa vai smṛtāḥ // LiP_2,27.108 //
children.translated_text: <s>Kāma</s>, <s>Īśa</s>, <s>Śveta</s>, and <s>Bhṛgu</s> — sixteen are declared. (LiP 2.27.108)
The <s>Mahimā</s> array has been described; hear from me the <s>Prāpti</s> (attainment) array.

children.text: saṃvarto lakulīśaśca vāḍavo hastireva ca // LiP_2,27.109 //
children.translated_text: <s>Saṃvarta</s>, <s>Lakulīśa</s>, <s>Vāḍava</s>, and <s>Hasti</s>; (LiP 2.27.109)
<s>Caṇḍayakṣa</s>, <s>Gaṇapati</s>, <s>Mahātmā</s>, and <s>Bhṛguja</s> as the eighth —
the first enclosure has been stated; hear the second enclosure. (LiP 2.27.110)

children.text: trivikramo mahājihvo ṛkṣaḥ śrībhadra eva ca /
children.translated_text: <s>Trivikrama</s>, <s>Mahājihva</s>, <s>Ṛkṣa</s>, and <s>Śrībhadra</s>;
<s>Mahādeva</s>, <s>Dadhīca</s>, <s>Kumāra</s>, and <s>Parāvara</s>; (LiP 2.27.111)
<s>Mahādaṃṣṭra</s>, <s>Karāla</s>, <s>Sūcaka</s>, and <s>Suvardhana</s>;
<s>Mahādhvāṅkṣa</s>, <s>Mahānanda</s>, <s>Daṇḍī</s>, and <s>Gopālaka</s>. (LiP 2.27.112)
The <s>Prāpti</s> array has been declared; hear the <s>Prākāmya</s> (irresistible will) [array], O one of excellent vows.
<s>Puṣpadanta</s>, <s>Mahānāga</s>, <s>Vipula</s>, and <s>Ānandakāraka</s>; (LiP 2.27.113)

children.text: śuklo viśālaḥ kamalo bilvaścāruma eva ca /
children.translated_text: <s>Śukla</s>, <s>Viśāla</s>, <s>Kamala</s>, <s>Bilva</s>, and <s>Cāruma</s> —
the first enclosure has been stated; hear the second enclosure. (LiP 2.27.114)
<s>Ratipriya</s>, <s>Sureśāna</s>, <s>Citrāṅga</s>, and <s>Sudurjaya</s>;
<s>Vināyaka</s>, <s>Kṣetrapāla</s>, <s>Mahāmoha</s>, and <s>Jaṅgala</s>; (LiP 2.27.115)
<s>Vatsaputra</s>, <s>Mahāputra</s>, <s>Grāmadeśādhipa</s>,
<s>Sarvāvasthādhipa</s>, the god <s>Meghanāda</s>, and <s>Pracaṇḍaka</s>; (LiP 2.27.116)
and <s>Kāladūta</s> is declared — [this is] the second enclosure.

children.text: prākāmyaḥ kathito vyūha aiśvaryaṃ kathayāmi te // LiP_2,27.117 //
children.translated_text: The <s>Prākāmya</s> array has been described; I shall tell you the <s>Aiśvarya</s> (sovereignty) [array]. (LiP 2.27.117)
<s>Maṅgalā</s>, <s>Carcikā</s>, <s>Yogeśā</s>, and <s>Haradāyikā</s>;

children.text: bhāsurā suramātā ca suṃdarī mātṛkāṣṭamī // LiP_2,27.118 //
children.translated_text: <s>Bhāsurā</s>, <s>Suramātā</s>, <s>Sundarī</s>, and <s>Mātṛkā</s> as the eighth — (LiP 2.27.118)
stated in the first enclosure; hear the second enclosure.
<s>Gaṇādhipa</s>, <s>Mantrajña</s>, <s>Varadeva</s>, and <s>Ṣaḍānana</s> (six-faced); (LiP 2.27.119)
<s>Vidagdha</s>, <s>Vicitra</s>, <s>Amogha</s>, and <s>Mogha</s>;
<s>Aśvīrudra</s>, <s>Someśa</s>, <s>Uttama</s>, and <s>Udumbara</s>; (LiP 2.27.120)
<s>Nārasiṃha</s>, <s>Vijaya</s>, and <s>Indraguha</s>, the lord;
and <s>Apāṃpati</s> (Lord of Waters) — according to the rite, the second enclosure. (LiP 2.27.121)
The <s>Aiśvarya</s> array has been described; <s>Vaśitva</s> (mastery) is now declared.
<s>Gagana</s>, <s>Bhavana</s>, <s>Vijaya</s>, and <s>Ajaya</s>; (LiP 2.27.122)
<s>Mahājaya</s>, <s>Aṅgāra</s>, <s>Vyaṅgāra</s>, and <s>Mahāyaśas</s> —
stated in the first enclosure; hear the second enclosure. (LiP 2.27.123)
<s>Sundara</s>, <s>Pracaṇḍeśa</s>, <s>Mahāvarṇa</s>, and <s>Mahāsura</s>;
<s>Mahāromā</s>, <s>Mahāgarbha</s>, <s>Prathama</s>, and <s>Kanaka</s>; (LiP 2.27.124)
<s>Kharaja</s>, <s>Garuḍa</s>, <s>Meghanāda</s>, and <s>Garjaka</s>;

children.text: gajaśca cchedako bāhustriśikho mārireva ca // LiP_2,27.125 //
children.translated_text: <s>Gaja</s>, <s>Cchedaka</s>, <s>Bāhu</s>, <s>Triśikha</s>, and <s>Māri</s>. (LiP 2.27.125)
The <s>Vaśitva</s> array has been described; hear the <s>Kāmāvasāyika</s> (desire-fulfillment) [array].

children.text: vinādo vikaṭaścaiva vasaṃto 'bhaya eva ca // LiP_2,27.126 //
children.translated_text: <s>Vināda</s>, <s>Vikaṭa</s>, <s>Vasanta</s>, and <s>Abhaya</s>; (LiP 2.27.126)
<s>Vidyut</s>, <s>Mahābala</s>, <s>Kamala</s>, and <s>Damana</s> —
the first enclosure has been stated; hear the second enclosure. (LiP 2.27.127)
<s>Dharma</s>, <s>Atibala</s>, <s>Sarpa</s>, <s>Mahākāya</s>, and <s>Mahāhanu</s>;
<s>Sabala</s>, <s>Bhasmāṅgī</s>, <s>Durjaya</s>, and <s>Duratikrama</s>; (LiP 2.27.128)

children.text: vetālo rauravaścaiva durdharo bhoga eva ca /
children.translated_text: <s>Vetāla</s>, <s>Raurava</s>, <s>Durdhara</s>, and <s>Bhoga</s>;
<s>Vajra</s>, <s>Kālāgnirudra</s>, <s>Sadyonāda</s>, and <s>Mahāguha</s>. (LiP 2.27.129)
The second enclosure has been stated, and the <s>Avasāyika</s> array.

children.text: kathitaḥ ṣoḍaśo vyūho dvitīyāvaraṇaṃ śṛṇu // LiP_2,27.130 //
children.translated_text: The sixteenth array has been described; hear the second enclosure. (LiP 2.27.130)
And in the second enclosure, in the <s>Dakṣa</s> array, the <s>Śaktis</s> —

children.text: prathamāvaraṇe cāṣṭau bāhye ṣoḍaśa eva ca // LiP_2,27.131 //
children.translated_text: eight in the first enclosure, and sixteen in the outer [one]. (LiP 2.27.131)
<s>Manoharā</s>, <s>Mahānādā</s>, <s>Citrā</s>, <s>Citrarathā</s>,

children.text: rohiṇī caiva citrāṅgī citrarekhā vicitrikā // LiP_2,27.132 //
children.translated_text: <s>Rohiṇī</s>, <s>Citrāṅgī</s>, <s>Citrarekhā</s>, and <s>Vicitrikā</s> — (LiP 2.27.132)
stated in the first enclosure; hear the second enclosure.

children.text: citrā vicitrarūpā ca śubhadā kāmadā subhā // LiP_2,27.133 //
children.translated_text: <s>Citrā</s>, <s>Vicitrarūpā</s>, <s>Śubhadā</s>, <s>Kāmadā</s>, <s>Subhā</s>; (LiP 2.27.133)

children.text: krūrā ca piṅgalā devī khaḍgikā laṃbikāsatī /
children.translated_text: <s>Krūrā</s>, <s>Piṅgalā Devī</s>, <s>Khaḍgikā</s>, <s>Lambikā</s>, <s>Satī</s>;
<s>Daṃṣṭrālī</s>, <s>Rākṣasīdhvaṃsī</s>, <s>Lolupā</s>, and <s>Lohitāmukhī</s> — (LiP 2.27.134)
in the second enclosure, sixteen in summary.

children.text: dakṣavyūhaḥ samākhyāto dākṣavyūhaṃ śṛṇuṣva me // LiP_2,27.135 //
children.translated_text: The <s>Dakṣa</s> array has been declared; hear from me the <s>Dākṣa</s> array. (LiP 2.27.135)
<s>Sarvāsatī</s>, <s>Viśvarūpā</s>, <s>Lampaṭā</s>, and <s>Āmiṣapriyā</s>;

children.text: dīrghadaṃṣṭrā ca vajrā ca laṃboṣṭhī prāṇahāriṇī // LiP_2,27.136 //
children.translated_text: <s>Dīrghadaṃṣṭrā</s>, <s>Vajrā</s>, <s>Lamboṣṭhī</s>, and <s>Prāṇahāriṇī</s> — (LiP 2.27.136)
the first enclosure has been stated; hear the second enclosure.
<s>Gajakarṇā</s>, <s>Aśvakarṇā</s>, <s>Mahākālī</s>, <s>Subhīṣaṇa</s>; (LiP 2.27.137)
<s>Vātavega</s>, <s>Ravā</s>, <s>Ghorā</s>, <s>Ghānāghanaravā</s>;

children.text: varaghoṣā mahāvarṇā sughaṇṭā ghaṇṭikā tathā // LiP_2,27.138 //
children.translated_text: <s>Varaghoṣā</s>, <s>Mahāvarṇā</s>, <s>Sughaṇṭā</s>, and <s>Ghaṇṭikā</s>. (LiP 2.27.138)
<s>Ghaṇṭeśvarī</s>, <s>Mahāghorā</s>, <s>Ghorā</s>, and also <s>Atighorikā</s> —
in the second ring (<s>āvaraṇa</s>), sixteen are proclaimed. (LiP 2,27.139)
The <s>Dākṣa</s>-formation has been described; hear from me the <s>Cāṇḍa</s>-formation.

children.text: atighaṇṭā cātighorā karālā karabhā tathā // LiP_2,27.140 //
children.translated_text: <s>Atighaṇṭā</s>, <s>Atighorā</s>, <s>Karālā</s>, and <s>Karabhā</s>, (LiP 2,27.140)
<s>Vibhūti</s>, <s>Bhogadā</s>, <s>Kānti</s>, and <s>Śaṅkhinī</s> as the eighth —
are declared in the first ring; hear the second ring. (LiP 2,27.141)
<s>Patriṇī</s>, <s>Gāndhārī</s>, <s>Yogamātā</s>, <s>Supīvarā</s>,

children.text: raktā mālāṃśukā vīrā saṃhārī māṃsahāriṇī // LiP_2,27.142 //
children.translated_text: <s>Raktā</s>, <s>Mālāṃśukā</s>, <s>Vīrā</s>, <s>Saṃhārī</s>, <s>Māṃsahāriṇī</s>, (LiP 2,27.142)
<s>Phalahārī</s>, <s>Jīvahārī</s>, <s>Svecchāhārī</s>, and <s>Tuṇḍikā</s>,

children.text: revatī raṅgiṇī saṃgā dvitīye ṣoḍaśaiva tu // LiP_2,27.143 //
children.translated_text: <s>Revatī</s>, <s>Raṅgiṇī</s>, <s>Saṅgā</s> — sixteen in the second [ring]. (LiP 2,27.143)
The <s>Caṇḍa</s>-formation has been described; the <s>Caṇḍā</s>-formation is now told.

children.text: caṇḍī caṇḍamukhī caṇḍā caṇḍavegā mahāravā // LiP_2,27.144 //
children.translated_text: <s>Caṇḍī</s>, <s>Caṇḍamukhī</s>, <s>Caṇḍā</s>, <s>Caṇḍavegā</s>, <s>Mahāravā</s>, (LiP 2,27.144)
<s>Bhrukuṭī</s>, <s>Caṇḍabhū</s>, and <s>Caṇḍarūpā</s> as the eighth —
the first ring is declared; hear the second ring. (LiP 2,27.145)
<s>Candraghrāṇā</s>, <s>Balā</s>, <s>Balajihvā</s>, <s>Baleśvarī</s>,

children.text: balavegā mahākāyā mahākopā ca vidyutā // LiP_2,27.146 //
children.translated_text: <s>Balavegā</s>, <s>Mahākāyā</s>, <s>Mahākopā</s>, and <s>Vidyutā</s>, (LiP 2,27.146)
<s>Kaṅkālī</s>, <s>Kalaśī</s>, <s>Vidyutā</s>, <s>Caṇḍaghoṣikā</s>,
<s>Mahāghoṣā</s>, <s>Mahārāvā</s>, <s>Caṇḍabhānaṅga</s>, and <s>Caṇḍikā</s>. (LiP 2,27.147)

children.text: caṇḍāyāḥ kathito vyūho haravyūhaṃ śṛṇuṣva me /
children.translated_text: The formation of <s>Caṇḍā</s> has been told; hear from me the <s>Hara</s>-formation.

children.text: caṇḍākṣī kāmadā devī sūkarī kukkuṭānanā // LiP_2,27.148 //
children.translated_text: <s>Caṇḍākṣī</s>, <s>Kāmadā</s>, the goddess <s>Sūkarī</s>, <s>Kukkuṭānanā</s>, (LiP 2,27.148)

children.text: gāndhārī dandubhī durgā saumitrā cāṣṭamī smṛtā /
children.translated_text: <s>Gāndhārī</s>, <s>Dandubhī</s>, <s>Durgā</s>, and <s>Saumitrā</s> as the eighth —
