the first ring is declared; hear the second ring. (LiP 2,27.149)
<s>Mṛtodbhavā</s>, <s>Mahālakṣmī</s>, <s>Varṇadā</s>, <s>Jīvarakṣiṇī</s>,

children.text: hariṇī kṣīṇajīvā ca daṇḍavaktrā caturbhujā // LiP_2,27.150 //
children.translated_text: <s>Hariṇī</s>, <s>Kṣīṇajīvā</s>, <s>Daṇḍavaktrā</s>, and <s>Caturbhujā</s>, (LiP 2,27.150)
<s>Vyomacārī</s>, <s>Vyomarūpā</s>, <s>Vyomavyāpī</s>, <s>Śubhodayā</s>,

children.text: gṛhacārī sucārī ca viṣāhārī viṣartihā // LiP_2,27.151 //
children.translated_text: <s>Gṛhacārī</s>, <s>Sucārī</s>, <s>Viṣāhārī</s>, and <s>Viṣartihā</s>. (LiP 2,27.151)
The <s>Hara</s>-formation has been described; the formation of <s>Harā</s> is now told.

children.text: jaṃbhācyutā ca kaṅkārī devikā durdharāvahā // LiP_2,27.152 //
children.translated_text: <s>Jaṃbhācyutā</s>, <s>Kaṅkārī</s>, <s>Devikā</s>, <s>Durdharāvahā</s>, (LiP 2,27.152)
<s>Caṇḍikā</s>, and <s>Capalā</s> — are remembered in the first ring.

children.text: cañjikā cāmarī caiva bhaṇḍikā ca śubhānanā // LiP_2,27.153 //
children.translated_text: <s>Cañjikā</s>, <s>Cāmarī</s>, <s>Bhaṇḍikā</s>, and <s>Śubhānanā</s>, (LiP 2,27.153)

children.text: piṇḍikā muṇḍikā muṇḍā śākinī śāṅkarī tathā /
children.translated_text: <s>Piṇḍikā</s>, <s>Muṇḍikā</s>, <s>Muṇḍā</s>, <s>Śākinī</s>, <s>Śāṅkarī</s> likewise,

children.text: kartarī bhartarī caiva bhāginī yajñadāyinī // LiP_2,27.154 //
children.translated_text: <s>Kartarī</s>, <s>Bhartarī</s>, <s>Bhāginī</s>, <s>Yajñadāyinī</s>, (LiP 2,27.154)
<s>Yamadaṃṣṭrā</s>, <s>Mahādaṃṣṭrā</s>, and <s>Karālā</s> — [these are] the <s>Śaktis</s>.

children.text: harāyāḥ kathito vyūhaḥ śaiṇḍavyūhaṃ śṛṇuṣva me // LiP_2,27.155 //
children.translated_text: The formation of <s>Harā</s> has been told; hear from me the <s>Śaiṇḍa</s>-formation. (LiP 2,27.155)
<s>Vikarālī</s>, <s>Karālī</s>, <s>Kālajaṅghā</s>, <s>Yaśasvinī</s>,

children.text: vegā vegavatī yajñā vedāṅgā cāṣṭamī smṛtā // LiP_2,27.156 //
children.translated_text: <s>Vegā</s>, <s>Vegavatī</s>, <s>Yajñā</s>, and <s>Vedāṅgā</s> as the eighth. (LiP 2,27.156)
The first ring is declared; hear the second ring.

children.text: vajrā śaṅkhātiśaṅkhā vā balā caivābalā tathā // LiP_2,27.157 //
children.translated_text: <s>Vajrā</s>, <s>Śaṅkhā</s> or <s>Atiśaṅkhā</s>, <s>Balā</s> and also <s>Abalā</s>, (LiP 2,27.157)

children.text: añjanī mohinī māyā vikaṭāṅgī nalī tathā /
children.translated_text: <s>Añjanī</s>, <s>Mohinī</s>, <s>Māyā</s>, <s>Vikaṭāṅgī</s>, and <s>Nalī</s>,

children.text: gaṇḍakī daḍakī ghoṇā śoṇā satyavatī tathā // LiP_2,27.158 //
children.translated_text: <s>Gaṇḍakī</s>, <s>Daḍakī</s>, <s>Ghoṇā</s>, <s>Śoṇā</s>, and <s>Satyavatī</s>, (LiP 2,27.158)
and <s>Kallolā</s> — in sequence, sixteen according to proper method.

children.text: śaiṇḍavyūhaḥ samākhyātaḥ śaiṇḍāyā vyūha ucyate // LiP_2,27.159 //
children.translated_text: The <s>Śaiṇḍa</s>-formation has been described; the formation of <s>Śaiṇḍā</s> is now told. (LiP 2,27.159)

children.text: danturā raudrabhāgā ca amṛtā sakulā śubhā /
children.translated_text: <s>Danturā</s>, <s>Raudrabhāgā</s>, <s>Amṛtā</s>, <s>Sakulā</s>, <s>Śubhā</s>,

children.text: calajihvāryanetrā ca rūpiṇī dārikā tathā // LiP_2,27.160 //
children.translated_text: <s>Calajihvā</s>, <s>Āryanetrā</s>, <s>Rūpiṇī</s>, and <s>Dārikā</s>. (LiP 2,27.160)
The first ring is declared; hear the second ring.

children.text: khādikā rūpanāmā ca saṃhārī ca kṣamāntakā // LiP_2,27.161 //
children.translated_text: <s>Khādikā</s>, <s>Rūpanāmā</s>, <s>Saṃhārī</s>, and <s>Kṣamāntakā</s>, (LiP 2,27.161)
<s>Kaṇḍinī</s>, <s>Peṣiṇī</s>, <s>Mahātrāsā</s>, and <s>Kṛtāntikā</s>,

children.text: daṇḍinī kiṅkarī biṃbā varṇinī cāmalāṅginī // LiP_2,27.162 //
children.translated_text: <s>Daṇḍinī</s>, <s>Kiṅkarī</s>, <s>Bimbā</s>, <s>Varṇinī</s>, and <s>Amalāṅginī</s>, (LiP 2,27.162)

children.text: draviṇī drāviṇī caiva śaktayaḥ ṣoḍaśaiva tu /
children.translated_text: <s>Draviṇī</s> and <s>Drāviṇī</s> — sixteen <s>Śaktis</s> indeed.

children.text: kathito hi manoramyaḥ śauṇḍāyā vyūha uttamaḥ // LiP_2,27.163 //
children.translated_text: The delightful supreme formation of <s>Śauṇḍā</s> has been told. (LiP 2,27.163)
I shall now describe the formation called <s>Prathamā</s>, of supreme beauty.

children.text: plavinī plāvanī śobhā mandā caiva madotkaṭā // LiP_2,27.164 //
children.translated_text: <s>Plavinī</s>, <s>Plāvanī</s>, <s>Śobhā</s>, <s>Mandā</s>, and <s>Madotkaṭā</s>, (LiP 2,27.164)
<s>Mandākṣepā</s> and <s>Mahādevī</s> — are remembered in the first ring.
<s>Kāmasaṃdīpinī</s>, the goddess <s>Atirūpā</s>, <s>Manoharā</s>, (LiP 2,27.165)
<s>Mahāvaśā</s>, <s>Mahāgrāhā</s>, <s>Vihvalā</s>, <s>Madavihvalā</s>,

children.text: aruṇā śoṣaṇā divyā revatī bhāṇḍanāyikā // LiP_2,27.166 //
children.translated_text: <s>Aruṇā</s>, <s>Śoṣaṇā</s>, <s>Divyā</s>, <s>Revatī</s>, and <s>Bhāṇḍanāyikā</s>, (LiP 2,27.166)
<s>Stambhinī</s>, <s>Ghoraraktākṣī</s>, <s>Smararūpā</s>, and <s>Sughoṣaṇā</s>.

children.text: vyūhaḥ prathama ākhyātaḥ svāyaṃbhuva yathā tathā // LiP_2,27.167 //
children.translated_text: The <s>Prathama</s>-formation has been described, O <s>Svāyaṃbhuva</s>, as it is. (LiP 2,27.167)
The <s>Prathama</s>-formation has been told; I shall describe [the next] — hear from me.
<s>Ghorā</s>, <s>Ghoratarā</s>, <s>Aghorā</s>, <s>Atighorā</s>, and <s>Aghanāyikā</s>, (LiP 2,27.168)
<s>Dhāvanī</s>, <s>Kroṣṭukā</s>, and <s>Muṇḍā</s> as the eighth are proclaimed.
The first ring is declared; hear the second ring. (LiP 2,27.169)

children.text: bhīmā bhīmatarā bhīmā śastā caiva suvartulā /
children.translated_text: <s>Bhīmā</s>, <s>Bhīmatarā</s>, <s>Bhīmā</s>, <s>Śastā</s>, and <s>Suvartulā</s>,

children.text: staṃbhinī rodanī raudrā rudravatyacalā calā // LiP_2,27.170 //
children.translated_text: <s>Stambhinī</s>, <s>Rodanī</s>, <s>Raudrā</s>, <s>Rudravatī</s>, <s>Acalā</s>, and <s>Calā</s>, (LiP 2,27.170)
<s>Mahābalā</s>, <s>Mahāśānti</s>, <s>Śālā</s>, <s>Śāntā</s>, <s>Śivāśivā</s>,
<s>Bṛhatkakṣā</s> and <s>Mahānāsā</s> — sixteen are proclaimed. (LiP 2,27.171)
The [formation] of <s>Prathamā</s> has been described; the <s>Manmatha</s>-formation is now told.

children.text: tālakarṇī ca bālā ca kalyāṇī kapilā śivā // LiP_2,27.172 //
children.translated_text: <s>Tālakarṇī</s>, <s>Bālā</s>, <s>Kalyāṇī</s>, <s>Kapilā</s>, <s>Śivā</s>, (LiP 2,27.172)
<s>Iṣṭi</s>, <s>Tuṣṭi</s>, and <s>Pratijñā</s> — are remembered in the first ring.

children.text: khyātiḥ puṣṭikarī tuṣṭirjalā caiva śrutirdhṛtiḥ // LiP_2,27.173 //
children.translated_text: <s>Khyāti</s>, <s>Puṣṭikarī</s>, <s>Tuṣṭi</s>, <s>Jalā</s>, <s>Śruti</s>, and <s>Dhṛti</s>, (LiP 2,27.173)
<s>Kāmadā</s>, <s>Śubhadā</s>, <s>Saumyā</s>, <s>Tejinī</s>, <s>Kāmatantrikā</s>,

children.text: dharmā dharmavaśā śīlā pāpahā dharmavardhinī // LiP_2,27.174 //
children.translated_text: <s>Dharmā</s>, <s>Dharmavaśā</s>, <s>Śīlā</s>, <s>Pāpahā</s>, and <s>Dharmavardhinī</s>. (LiP 2,27.174)

children.text: manmathaḥ kathito vyūho manmathāyāḥ śṛṇuṣva me /
children.translated_text: The <s>Manmatha</s>-formation has been told; hear from me [the formation] of <s>Manmathā</s>.

children.text: dharmarakṣā vidhānā ca dharmā dharmavatī tathā // LiP_2,27.175 //
children.translated_text: <s>Dharmarakṣā</s>, <s>Vidhānā</s>, <s>Dharmā</s>, and <s>Dharmavatī</s>, (LiP 2,27.175)
<s>Sumati</s>, <s>Durmati</s>, <s>Medhā</s>, and <s>Vimalā</s> as the eighth.
The first ring is declared; hear the second ring. (LiP 2,27.176)
<s>Śuddhi</s>, <s>Buddhi</s>, <s>Dyuti</s>, <s>Kānti</s>, <s>Vartulā</s>, <s>Mohavardhinī</s>,

children.text: balā cātibalā bhīmā prāṇavṛddhikarī tathā // LiP_2,27.177 //
children.translated_text: <s>Balā</s>, <s>Atibalā</s>, <s>Bhīmā</s>, and <s>Prāṇavṛddhikarī</s>, (LiP 2,27.177)
<s>Nirlajjā</s>, <s>Nirghṛṇā</s>, <s>Mandā</s>, <s>Sarvapāpakṣayaṅkarī</s>,
<s>Kapilā</s>, and <s>Atividhurā</s> — these sixteen are proclaimed. (LiP 2,27.178)
The [formation] of <s>Manmathā</s> has been told to you; I shall also tell the <s>Bhīma</s>-formation.

children.text: raktā caiva viraktā ca udvegā śokavardhinī // LiP_2,27.179 //
children.translated_text: <s>Raktā</s>, <s>Viraktā</s>, <s>Udvegā</s>, <s>Śokavardhinī</s>, (LiP 2,27.179)

children.text: kāmā tṛṣṇā kṣudhā mohā cāṣṭamī parikīrtitā /
children.translated_text: <s>Kāmā</s>, <s>Tṛṣṇā</s>, <s>Kṣudhā</s>, and <s>Mohā</s> as the eighth are proclaimed.
The first ring is declared; hear the second ring. (LiP 2,27.180)
<s>Jayā</s>, <s>Nidrā</s>, <s>Bhayā</s>, <s>Lasyā</s>, <s>Jalatṛṣṇā</s>, <s>Udarī</s>, <s>Darā</s>,

children.text: kṛṣṇā kṛṣṇāṅginī vṛddhā śuddhocchiṣṭāśanī vṛṣā // LiP_2,27.181 //
children.translated_text: <s>Kṛṣṇā</s>, <s>Kṛṣṇāṅginī</s>, <s>Vṛddhā</s>, <s>Śuddha</s>, <s>Ucchiṣṭāśanī</s>, <s>Vṛṣā</s>, (LiP 2,27.181)
<s>Kāmanā</s>, <s>Śobhinī</s>, <s>Dagdhā</s>, <s>Duḥkhadā</s>, and <s>Sukhadāvalī</s>.
The <s>Bhīma</s>-formation has been described; the formation of <s>Bhīmā</s> is now told. (LiP 2,27.182)

children.text: ānandā ca sunandā ca mahānandā subhaṅkarī /
children.translated_text: <s>Ānandā</s>, <s>Sunandā</s>, <s>Mahānandā</s>, and <s>Subhaṅkarī</s>,
<s>Vatirāgā</s>, <s>Mahotsāhā</s>, <s>Jitarāgā</s>, and <s>Manoratā</s>. (LiP 2,27.183)
The first ring is declared; hear the second ring.
<s>Manonmanī</s>, <s>Manaḥkṣobhā</s>, <s>Madonmattā</s>, and <s>Gadākulā</s>, (LiP 2,27.184)
<s>Mandagārbhā</s>, <s>Mahābhāsā</s>, <s>Kāmānandā</s>, and <s>Suvihvalā</s>,

children.text: mahāvegā suvegā ca mahābhogā kṣayāvahā // LiP_2,27.185 //
children.translated_text: <s>Mahāvegā</s>, <s>Suvegā</s>, <s>Mahābhogā</s>, and <s>Kṣayāvahā</s>, (LiP 2,27.185)
<s>Kramiṇī</s>, <s>Kramiṇī</s>, and <s>Vakrā</s> — are remembered in the second ring.
The supremely beautiful formation of <s>Bhīmā</s> has been told to you. (LiP 2,27.186)
Now I shall tell the <s>Śākuna</s>-[formation], O <s>Svāyaṃbhuva</s>, [you who are] eager in mind.

children.text: yogā vegā suvegā ca ativegā suvāsinī // LiP_2,27.187 //
children.translated_text: <s>Yogā</s>, <s>Vegā</s>, <s>Suvegā</s>, <s>Ativegā</s>, and <s>Suvāsinī</s>, (LiP 2,27.187)

children.text: devī manorayā vegā jalāvartā ca dhīmatī /
children.translated_text: the goddess <s>Manorayā</s>, <s>Vegā</s>, <s>Jalāvartā</s>, and <s>Dhīmatī</s>.
The first ring is declared; hear the second ring. (LiP 2,27.188)
<s>Rodhinī</s>, <s>Kṣobhiṇī</s>, <s>Bālā</s>, <s>Viprā</s>, <s>Śeṣā</s>, <s>Suśoṣiṇī</s>,

children.text: vidyutā bhāsinī devī manovegā ca cāpalā // LiP_2,27.189 //
children.translated_text: <s>Vidyutā</s>, <s>Bhāsinī</s>, the goddess <s>Manovegā</s>, and <s>Cāpalā</s>, (LiP 2,27.189)
<s>Vidyujjihvā</s>, <s>Mahājihvā</s>, <s>Bhṛkuṭī</s>, <s>Kuṭilānanā</s>,

children.text: phullajvālā mahājvālā sujvālā ca kṣayāntikā // LiP_2,27.190 //
children.translated_text: <s>Phullajvālā</s>, <s>Mahājvālā</s>, <s>Sujvālā</s>, and <s>Kṣayāntikā</s>. (LiP 2,27.190)
The <s>Śākuna</s>-formation has been told; hear from me [the formation] of <s>Śākunā</s>.

children.text: jvālinī caiva bhasmāṅgī tathā bhasmāntagā tatā // LiP_2,27.191 //
children.translated_text: <s>Jvālinī</s>, <s>Bhasmāṅgī</s>, and <s>Bhasmāntagā</s>, (LiP 2,27.191)

children.text: bhāvinī ca prajā vidyā khyātiścaivāṣṭamī smṛtā /
children.translated_text: <s>Bhāvinī</s>, <s>Prajā</s>, <s>Vidyā</s>, and <s>Khyāti</s> as the eighth.
The first ring is declared; hear the second ring. (LiP 2,27.192)

children.text: ullekhā ca patākā ca bhogābhogavatī khagā /
children.translated_text: <s>Ullekhā</s>, <s>Patākā</s>, <s>Bhogā</s>, <s>Bhogavatī</s>, <s>Khagā</s>,
<s>Bhogabhogavratā</s>, <s>Yogā</s>, <s>Bhogākhyā</s>, and <s>Yogapāragā</s>, (LiP 2,27.193)
<s>Ṛddhi</s>, <s>Buddhi</s>, <s>Dhṛti</s>, <s>Kānti</s>, <s>Smṛti</s>, <s>Sākṣāt Śruti</s>, and <s>Dharā</s>.
The great formation of <s>Śākunā</s>, the wish-granting one, has been told. (LiP 2,27.194)
O <s>Svāyaṃbhuva</s>, hear the formation called <s>Sumati</s>, of great beauty.

children.text: pareṣṭā ca parā dṛṣṭā hyamṛtā phalanāśinī // LiP_2,27.195 //
children.translated_text: <s>Pareṣṭā</s>, <s>Parā</s>, <s>Dṛṣṭā</s>, <s>Amṛtā</s>, <s>Phalanāśinī</s>, (LiP 2,27.195)
<s>Hiraṇyākṣī</s>, <s>Suvarṇākṣī</s>, the goddess who is manifestly <s>Kapiñjalā</s>,

children.text: kāmarekhā ca kathitaṃ prathamāvaraṇaṃ śṛṇu // LiP_2,27.196 //
children.translated_text: and <s>Kāmarekhā</s> — the first ring has been told; hear. (LiP 2,27.196)
<s>Ratnadvīpā</s>, <s>Sudvīpā</s>, <s>Ratnadā</s>, <s>Ratnamālinī</s>,

children.text: ratnaśobhā suśobhā ca mahāśobhā mahādyutiḥ // LiP_2,27.197 //
children.translated_text: <s>Ratnaśobhā</s>, <s>Suśobhā</s>, <s>Mahāśobhā</s>, and <s>Mahādyuti</s>, (LiP 2,27.197)
<s>Śāṃbarī</s>, <s>Bandhurā</s>, <s>Granthi</s>, <s>Pādakarṇā</s>, <s>Karānanā</s>,

children.text: hayagrīvā ca jihvā ca sarvabhāsoti śaktayaḥ // LiP_2,27.198 //
children.translated_text: <s>Hayagrīvā</s>, <s>Jihvā</s>, and <s>Sarvabhāsā</s> — [these are] the <s>Śaktis</s>. (LiP 2,27.198)
The <s>Sumati</s>-formation has been told; the formation of <s>Sumatī</s> is now described.
<s>Sarvāśī</s>, <s>Mahābhakṣā</s>, <s>Mahādaṃṣṭrā</s>, and <s>Atirauravā</s>, (LiP 2,27.199)
<s>Visphuliṅgā</s>, <s>Viliṅgā</s>, <s>Kṛtāntā</s>, and <s>Bhāskarānanā</s>.
The first ring is declared; hear the second ring. (LiP 2,27.200)

children.text: rāgā raṅgāvatī śreṣṭhā mahākrodhā ca rauravā /
children.translated_text: <s>Rāgā</s>, <s>Raṅgāvatī</s>, <s>Śreṣṭhā</s>, <s>Mahākrodhā</s>, and <s>Rauravā</s>,

children.text: krodhanī vasanīcaiva kalahā ca mahābalā // LiP_2,27.201 //
children.translated_text: <s>Krodhanī</s>, <s>Vasanī</s>, <s>Kalahā</s>, and <s>Mahābalā</s>, (LiP 2,27.201)
<s>Kalantikā</s>, <s>Caturbhedā</s>, <s>Durgā</s>, <s>Durgamāninī</s>,

children.text: nālī sunālī saumyā ca ityevaṃ kathitaṃ mayā // LiP_2,27.202 //
children.translated_text: <s>Nālī</s>, <s>Sunālī</s>, and <s>Saumyā</s> — thus it has been told by me. (LiP 2,27.202)
I shall now tell the <s>Gopa</s>-formation here; hear the whole, O <s>Svāyaṃbhuva</s>.

children.text: pāṭalī pāṭavī caiva pāṭī vidipiṭā tathā // LiP_2,27.203 //
children.translated_text: <s>Pāṭalī</s>, <s>Pāṭavī</s>, <s>Pāṭī</s>, and <s>Vidipiṭā</s>, (LiP 2,27.203)

children.text: kaṅkaṭā supaṭā caiva praghaṭā ca ghaṭodbhavā /
children.translated_text: <s>Kaṅkaṭā</s>, <s>Supaṭā</s>, <s>Praghaṭā</s>, and <s>Ghaṭodbhavā</s>.

children.text: prathamāvaraṇaṃ cātra bhāṣayā kathitaṃ mayā // LiP_2,27.204 //
children.translated_text: The first ring here — has been told by me in words. (LiP 2,27.204)
<s>Nādākṣī</s>, <s>Nādarūpā</s>, <s>Sarvakārī</s>, <s>Gamāgamā</s>,

children.text: anucārī sucārī ca caṇḍanāḍī suvāhinī // LiP_2,27.205 //
children.translated_text: <s>Anucārī</s>, <s>Sucārī</s>, <s>Caṇḍanāḍī</s>, and <s>Suvāhinī</s>, (LiP 2,27.205)

children.text: suyogā ca viyogā ca haṃsākhyā ca vilāsinī /
children.translated_text: <s>Suyogā</s>, <s>Viyogā</s>, <s>Haṃsākhyā</s>, and <s>Vilāsinī</s>,

children.text: sarvagā suvicārā ca vañcanī ceti śaktayaḥ // LiP_2,27.206 //
children.translated_text: <s>Sarvagā</s>, <s>Suvicārā</s>, and <s>Vañcanī</s> — [these are] the <s>Śaktis</s>. (LiP 2,27.206)
The <s>Gopa</s>-formation has been described; the formation of <s>Gopā</s> is now told.

children.text: bhedinī ccedinī caiva sarvakārī kṣudhāśanī // LiP_2,27.207 //
children.translated_text: <s>Bhedinī</s>, <s>Chedinī</s>, <s>Sarvakārī</s>, and <s>Kṣudhāśanī</s>, (LiP 2,27.207)
<s>Ucchuṣmā</s>, <s>Gāndhārī</s>, <s>Bhasmāśī</s>, and <s>Vaḍavānalā</s>.
The first ring; hear the second ring. (LiP 2,27.208)

children.text: andhā bāhvāsinī bālā dīkṣapāmā tathaiva ca /
children.translated_text: <s>Andhā</s>, <s>Bāhvāsinī</s>, <s>Bālā</s>, and <s>Dīkṣapāmā</s> likewise,

children.text: akṣātryakṣā ca hṛllekhā hṛdgatā māyikāparā // LiP_2,27.209 //
children.translated_text: <s>Akṣā</s>, <s>Tryakṣā</s>, <s>Hṛllekhā</s>, <s>Hṛdgatā</s>, and <s>Māyikā Parā</s>, (LiP 2,27.209)
<s>Āmayā</s>, <s>Sādinī</s>, <s>Bhillī</s>, <s>Sahyā</s>, <s>Asahyā</s>, and <s>Sarasvatī</s>,
<s>Rudraśakti</s>, <s>Mahāśakti</s>, <s>Mahāmohā</s>, and <s>Gonadī</s>. (LiP 2,27.210)

children.text: gopāyī kathito vyūho nandavyūhaṃ vadāmi te /
children.translated_text: The <s>Gopā</s>-formation has been told; I shall tell you the <s>Nanda</s>-formation.

children.text: nandinī ca nivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca yathākramam // LiP_2,27.211 //
children.translated_text: <s>Nandinī</s>, <s>Nivṛtti</s>, and <s>Pratiṣṭhā</s>, in sequence, (LiP 2,27.211)
<s>Vidyā</s>, <s>Nāsā</s>, <s>Khagrasinī</s>, <s>Cāmuṇḍā</s>, and <s>Priyadarśinī</s>.
The first ring is declared; hear the second ring. (LiP 2,27.212)

children.text: gṛhyā nārāyaṇī mohā prajā devī ca cakriṇī /
children.translated_text: <s>Gṛhyā</s>, <s>Nārāyaṇī</s>, <s>Mohā</s>, <s>Prajā</s>, the goddess <s>Cakriṇī</s>,

children.text: kaṅkaṭā ca tathā kālī śivādyoṣā tataḥ param // LiP_2,27.213 //
children.translated_text: <s>Kaṅkaṭā</s>, and <s>Kālī</s>, and <s>Śivā</s>-<s>Dyoṣā</s>; then beyond that — (LiP 2,27.213)

children.text: virāmā yā ca vāgīśī vāhinībhīṣaṇī tathā /
children.translated_text: <s>Virāmā</s>, <s>Vāgīśī</s>, <s>Vāhinī</s>, and <s>Bhīṣaṇī</s>,

children.text: sugamā caiva nirdiṣṭā dvitayivaraṇe smṛtā // LiP_2,27.214 //
children.translated_text: and <s>Sugamā</s> are specified — remembered in the second ring. (LiP 2,27.214)

children.text: nandavyūho mayā khyāto nandāyā vyūha ucyate /
children.translated_text: The <s>Nandavyūha</s> (array of Nanda) has been declared by me; now the array of <s>Nandā</s> is described.

children.text: vināyakī pūrṇimā ca raṅkārī kuṇḍalī tathā // LiP_2,27.215 //
children.translated_text: <s>Vināyakī</s>, <s>Pūrṇimā</s>, <s>Raṅkārī</s>, and <s>Kuṇḍalī</s>, (LiP 2.27.215)

children.text: icchā kapālinī caiva dvīpinī ca jayantikā /
children.translated_text: <s>Icchā</s>, <s>Kapālinī</s>, <s>Dvīpinī</s>, and <s>Jayantikā</s> —
these eight <s>Śaktis</s> are declared in the first enclosure. (LiP 2.27.216)
The first enclosure has been stated; hear the second enclosure.

children.text: pāvanī cāṃbikā caiva sarvātmā pūtanā tathā // LiP_2,27.217 //
children.translated_text: <s>Pāvanī</s>, <s>Āmbikā</s>, <s>Sarvātmā</s>, and <s>Pūtanā</s>, (LiP 2.27.217)
<s>Chagalī</s>, <s>Modinī</s>, the goddess <s>Lambodarī</s>,

children.text: saṃhāri kālinī caiva kusumā ca yatākramam // LiP_2,27.218 //
children.translated_text: <s>Saṃhāri</s>, <s>Kālinī</s>, and <s>Kusumā</s> in due order, (LiP 2.27.218)

children.text: śukraā tārā tathā jñānā kriyā gāyatrikā tathā /
children.translated_text: <s>Śukrā</s>, <s>Tārā</s>, <s>Jñānā</s>, <s>Kriyā</s>, <s>Gāyatrikā</s>,

children.text: sāvitrī ceti vidhinā dvitīyā varaṇaṃ smṛtam // LiP_2,27.219 //
children.translated_text: and <s>Sāvitrī</s> — thus according to rule the second enclosure is known. (LiP 2.27.219)
The array of <s>Nandā</s> has been described; beyond that is the <s>Paitāmaha</s> (of Brahmā) [array].

children.text: nandinī caiva phetkārī krodhā haṃsā ṣaḍaṅgulā // LiP_2,27.220 //
children.translated_text: <s>Nandinī</s>, <s>Phetkārī</s>, <s>Krodhā</s>, <s>Haṃsā</s>, <s>Ṣaḍaṅgulā</s>, (LiP 2.27.220)
<s>Ānandā</s>, <s>Vasudurgā</s>, <s>Saṃhārā</s>, and <s>Amṛtāṣṭamī</s> —
the first enclosure has been stated; hear the second enclosure. (LiP 2.27.221)
<s>Kulāntikānalā</s>, <s>Pracaṇḍā</s>, and <s>Mardinī</s>,

children.text: sarvabhūtābhayā caiva dayā ca vaḍavāmukhī // LiP_2,27.222 //
children.translated_text: <s>Sarvabhūtābhayā</s>, <s>Dayā</s>, and <s>Vaḍavāmukhī</s>, (LiP 2.27.222)
<s>Lampaṭā</s>, <s>Pannagā</s>, the goddess <s>Kusumā</s>, <s>Vipulāntakā</s>,

children.text: kedārā ca tathā kūrmā duritā mandarodarī // LiP_2,27.223 //
children.translated_text: <s>Kedārā</s>, <s>Kūrmā</s>, <s>Duritā</s>, and <s>Mandarodarī</s> — (LiP 2.27.223)
with sword and discus according to rule, the second enclosure is known.
The <s>Paitāmaha</s> array is declared, granting <s>dharma</s>, <s>kāma</s>, <s>artha</s>, and <s>mukti</s>. (LiP 2.27.224)

children.text: pitāmahāyā vyūhaṃ ca kathayāmi śṛṇuṣva me /
children.translated_text: I shall now describe the array of <s>Pitāmahā</s> (the Grandmother); listen to me.

children.text: vajrā ca nandanā śāvarāvikā ripubhedinī // LiP_2,27.225 //
children.translated_text: <s>Vajrā</s>, <s>Nandanā</s>, <s>Śāvarāvikā</s>, <s>Ripubhedinī</s>, (LiP 2.27.225)

children.text: rūpā caturthā yogā ca prathamāvaraṇe smṛtāḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Rūpā</s>, <s>Caturthā</s>, and <s>Yogā</s> — these are known in the first enclosure.

children.text: bhūtā nādā mahābālā kharparā ca tathā parā // LiP_2,27.226 //
children.translated_text: <s>Bhūtā</s>, <s>Nādā</s>, <s>Mahābālā</s>, <s>Kharparā</s>, and <s>Parā</s>, (LiP 2.27.226)
<s>Bhasmā</s>, <s>Kāntā</s>, <s>Vṛṣṭi</s>, two-armed, of <s>Brahma</s>-form,

children.text: saihyā vaikārikā jātā karmamoṭī tathāparā // LiP_2,27.227 //
children.translated_text: <s>Saihyā</s>, <s>Vaikārikā</s>, <s>Jātā</s>, and <s>Karmamoṭī</s>, (LiP 2.27.227)
<s>Mahāmohā</s>, <s>Mahāmāyā</s>, <s>Gāndhārī</s>, <s>Puṣpamālinī</s>,

children.text: śabdāpī ca mahāghoṣā ṣoḍaśaiva tathāntime // LiP_2,27.228 //
children.translated_text: <s>Śabdāpī</s>, and <s>Mahāghoṣā</s> — these sixteen in the last [enclosure]. (LiP 2.27.228)
All these goddesses are two-armed, resembling the rising sun,
bearing lotus and conch, peaceful, adorned with red garlands and garments. (LiP 2.27.229)
Complete with all ornaments, decorated with crowns and the like,
with divine [ornaments] made of pearls, jeweled, variegated, and lovely — (LiP 2.27.230)
adorned, of fair complexion — the goddesses should be meditated upon individually.

children.text: evaṃ sahasrakalaśaṃ tāmrajaṃ mṛnmayaṃ tu vā // LiP_2,27.231 //
children.translated_text: Thus the thousand-vessel (<s>sahasrakalaśa</s>) [consecration], whether of copper or clay, (LiP 2.27.231)
endowed with the previously stated characteristics, established in the field of <s>Rudra</s>,
[worshipped] with the thousand names beginning with <s>Bhava</s> and others as declared by <s>Viṣṇu</s> — (LiP 2.27.232)
having worshipped, one should arrange [them] before [the deity] and sprinkle the <s>Bāṇa</s>-form (<s>liṅga</s>).
Having consecrated and announced, one should sprinkle the king. (LiP 2.27.233)
Thus the thousand-vessel [consecration] bestows the fruit of all <s>siddhis</s>,
the great array of forty [groups], marked with all auspicious signs. (LiP 2.27.234)
The vessels for all [groups] are described as previously, made of gold.
All are filled with fragrant water and endowed with the five gems. (LiP 2.27.235)
Likewise furnished with gold, filled with ghee for the deity,

children.text: kṣīreṇa vātha dadhnā vā pañcagavyena vā punaḥ // LiP_2,27.236 //
children.translated_text: or with milk, or with curd, or again with the five cow-products (<s>pañcagavya</s>). (LiP 2.27.236)
Or with <s>brahmakūrca</s> — the consecration is performed in the middle.
With the <s>Rudrādhyāya</s> [is performed the rite] of <s>Rudra</s>; hear, O best of kings. (LiP 2.27.237)
To the non-terrifying ones, and to the terrifying ones, and to those more terrifying than the terrifying —

children.text: sarvebhyaḥ sarvaśarvebhyo namaste astu rudrarūpebhyaḥ // LiP_2,27.238 //
children.translated_text: to all, to all <s>Śarvas</s>, salutation be to those of <s>Rudra</s>-form! (LiP 2.27.238)
With this mantra one should sprinkle the king who has been consecrated.
The <s>homa</s> (fire-oblation) also with this mantra, the <s>Aghora</s> [mantra] that destroys sin — (LiP 2.27.239)

children.text: prāgādyaṃ devakuṇḍe vā sthāṇḍile vā ghṛtādibhiḥ /
children.translated_text: beginning from the east, in the divine fire-pit (<s>devakuṇḍa</s>) or on the ground-altar (<s>sthaṇḍila</s>), with ghee and the like,
with fuel-sticks, ghee, cooked rice, parched grain, rice, and <s>nīvāra</s> (wild rice) — (LiP 2.27.240)
having offered one hundred and eight [oblations], one should perform the preliminary consecration (<s>adhivāsa</s>) of the king.

children.text: puṇyāhaṃ svasti rudrāya kautukaṃ hemanirmitam // LiP_2,27.241 //
children.translated_text: 'Auspiciousness! Blessings to <s>Rudra</s>!' — the auspicious thread (<s>kautuka</s>), made of gold, (LiP 2.27.241)
and sacred ash with lotus stalk, one should bind on the right hand.
'We worship the three-eyed one (<s>Tryambaka</s>), the fragrant one, the increaser of prosperity — (LiP 2.27.242)
may He liberate us from death like a cucumber from its bond, but not from immortality!'
With this mantra one should sprinkle the king or else perform <s>homa</s>. (LiP 2.27.243)
The consecration with all substances and the oblation-substances in due order,
beginning from the east, as declared by the <s>brāhmaṇas</s>, with all substances in due order — (LiP 2.27.244)

children.text:
tatpuraṣāya vidmahe mahādevāya dhīmahi /
tanno rudraḥ pracodayāt // LiP_2,27.245 //

children.translated_text: With the <s>Puruṣa</s> [mantra] ending in <s>svāhā</s>, thus in the eastern fire-pit the twice-born should offer oblations.

children.text: aghoreṇa ca yāmye ca homayetkṛṣṇavāsasā // LiP_2,27.246 //
children.translated_text: With the <s>Aghora</s> [mantra] in the southern [pit], one should offer wearing black garments. (LiP 2.27.246)
'We know <s>Tatpuruṣa</s>, we meditate on <s>Mahādeva</s> — may <s>Rudra</s> inspire us!' (LiP 2.27.245)

children.text: vāmadevāya namo jyeṣṭhāya namaḥ śreṣṭhāya namo rudrāya namaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Salutation to <s>Vāmadeva</s>! Salutation to the eldest! Salutation to the best! Salutation to <s>Rudra</s>!'
In this manner, with the prescribed sequence, one should offer in the western [pit]. (LiP 2.27.247)
With the <s>Sadya</s> [mantra] is the <s>homa</s> in the western [pit], with all substances in due order.

children.text: sadyojātaṃ prapadyāmi sadyojātāya vai namaḥ // LiP_2,27.248 //
children.translated_text: 'I take refuge in <s>Sadyojāta</s>; salutation indeed to <s>Sadyojāta</s>! (LiP 2.27.248)

children.text: bhave bhavenāti bhave bhavasva māṃ bhavodbhavāya namaḥ /
children.translated_text: In existence, through existence, beyond existence — be favorable to me! Salutation to the source of existence!'
Ending in <s>svāhā</s>, the wise one should offer into the fire with this mantra. (LiP 2.27.249)

children.text: āgneyyāṃ ca vidhānena ṛcā raudreṇa homayet /
children.translated_text: In the southeastern [pit], according to rule, one should offer with the <s>Raudra</s> (of Rudra) verse.
'We press <s>Soma</s> for <s>Jātavedas</s> (Fire)' — with this and the like, then
in the southwestern [pit], as before, with all substances the <s>homa</s> is performed. (LiP 2.27.250)
With this divine mantra that accomplishes all <s>siddhis</s>:

children.text: nimi niśi diśa svāhā khaḍga rākṣasa bhedana // LiP_2,27.251 //
children.translated_text: '<s>Nimi</s>, at night, in the direction — <s>svāhā</s>! O sword, O slayer of <s>rākṣasas</s>, (LiP 2.27.251)
moist with blood and ghee — to <s>Nairṛtī</s>, <s>svāhā</s>! Salutation! <s>Svadhā</s>! Salutation!'
With desired substances, according to rule, one should offer with this mantra. (LiP 2.27.252)
In the southern [pit] with various substances, with the <s>Īśāna</s> [mantra], O best of twice-born;
in the northeastern [pit], with the previously stated substances, one should perform the <s>homa</s>. (LiP 2.27.253)

children.text: iśānāya kadrudrāya pracetase tryaṃbakāya śarvāya tanno rudraḥ pracodayāt // LiP_2,27.254 //
children.translated_text: 'To <s>Īśāna</s>, to the fierce <s>Rudra</s>, to the wise one, to <s>Tryambaka</s>, to <s>Śarva</s> — may <s>Rudra</s> inspire us!' (LiP 2.27.254)
The principal [oblation] with the previously stated substances, with the <s>Īśāna</s> [mantra], O best of twice-born —
one should offer a thousand of each substance in the presence of the king. (LiP 2.27.255)
Or the king himself, devoted to <s>Śiva</s>, should offer into the fire.

children.text: īśānaḥ sarvavidyānāmīśvīraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ brahmādhipatirbrahmaṇo 'dhipatirbrahmā śivo me astu sadā śivom // LiP_2,27.256 //
children.translated_text: '<s>Īśāna</s> is the lord of all knowledge, the lord of all beings; the overlord of <s>Brahman</s>, the master of <s>Brahman</s>; <s>Brahmā</s> — may <s>Śiva</s> ever be auspicious to me, ever auspicious!' (LiP 2.27.256)
The expiation (<s>prāyaścitta</s>) with the <s>Aghora</s> [mantra]; the remainder should be performed as standard.
The king who has undergone the preliminary consecration, with the sounds of conches, kettledrums, and the like, (LiP 2.27.257)
with divine cries of 'Victory!' and splendid Vedic chanting,
should be sprinkled with the <s>kūrca</s>-water or aspersed, O best of kings. (LiP 2.27.258)
With the <s>Rudrādhyāya</s>, according to rule, wearing sacred ash and <s>Rudra</s>'s marks,
conch, fly-whisk, kettledrum, and a parasol bright as the moon — (LiP 2.27.259)
the palanquin and the victory-banner should be prepared, auspicious, for the king.
For the <s>kṣatriya</s> endowed with royal consecration, or for a lord — (LiP 2.27.260)
the insignia of kingship are not ordained for other <s>kṣatriyas</s>.
The standard measure for all [ritual items] is declared to be twelve <s>aṅgulas</s>. (LiP 2.27.261)
<s>Palāśa</s>, <s>udumbara</s>, <s>aśvattha</s>, and <s>vaṭa</s> [trees] — from the east onward, in order;

children.text: toraṇādyāni vai tatra paṭṭamātreṇa paṭṭikāḥ // LiP_2,27.262 //
children.translated_text: the gateways (<s>toraṇa</s>) and the like there, with cloth strips (<s>paṭṭikā</s>) of cloth measure. (LiP 2.27.262)
Covered with garlands of <s>darbha</s> grass of eight <s>aṅgulas</s>,
furnished with eight directional banners and door-pots, splendid — (LiP 2.27.263)
adorned with golden gateway-pots, one should bathe the king.
Seated at the highest [position], one should consecrate him with the <s>Śiva</s>-pot. (LiP 2.27.264)

children.text:
tanmaheśāya vidmahe vāgviśuddhāya dhīmahi /
tannaḥ śivaḥ pracodayāt // LiP_2,27.265 //

children.translated_text: With this mantra, according to rule, with the prosperity-chant (<s>vardhanī</s>), with the song of <s>Gaurī</s>,

children.text: rudrādhyāyena vā sarvamaghorāyātha vā punaḥ // LiP_2,27.266 //
children.translated_text: or with the <s>Rudrādhyāya</s>, or again with the <s>Aghorā</s> [mantra] — (LiP 2.27.266)
'We know <s>Maheśa</s>, we meditate on the One of purified speech — may <s>Śiva</s> inspire us!' (LiP 2.27.265)
with divine ornaments, white, with crowns and the like, well-arranged,
with silk garments, one should please the king gently and steadily. (LiP 2.27.267)
Having made a <s>sudarśana</s> (discus image) of gold weighing sixty-eight <s>palas</s>,
adorned with nine gems, one should give it as <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (fee) to the guru. (LiP 2.27.268)
Ten cows with garments, and a beautiful field,
a hundred <s>droṇas</s> of sesame and a hundred <s>droṇas</s> of rice — (LiP 2.27.269)
a bed, a vehicle, a couch with pillows one should give.
For all <s>yogins</s>, thirty <s>palas</s> [of gold] is prescribed. (LiP 2.27.270)
For all others, half of that; for devotees of <s>Śiva</s>, half of that again.

children.text: mahāpūjāṃ tataḥ kuryānmahādevasya vai nṛpaḥ // LiP_2,27.271 //
children.translated_text: The king should then perform great worship (<s>mahāpūjā</s>) of <s>Mahādeva</s>. (LiP 2.27.271)
Thus has been briefly described the supreme victory-consecration (<s>jayasecana</s>).
Having been thus consecrated in ancient times, <s>Śakra</s> (Indra) attained the status of <s>Śakra</s>. (LiP 2.27.272)
<s>Brahmā</s> attained <s>Brahma</s>-hood, <s>Viṣṇu</s> attained <s>Viṣṇu</s>-hood,

children.text: aṃbikā cāṃbikātvaṃ ca saubhāgyamatulaṃ tathā // LiP_2,27.273 //
children.translated_text: <s>Ambikā</s> attained the state of <s>Ambikā</s> and matchless good fortune. (LiP 2.27.273)

children.text: sāvitrī ca tathā lakṣmīrdevī kātyāyanī tathā /
children.translated_text: <s>Sāvitrī</s> likewise, and <s>Lakṣmī</s>, and the goddess <s>Kātyāyanī</s>.

children.text: nandinātha purā mṛtyū rudrādhyāyena vai jitaḥ // LiP_2,27.274 //
children.translated_text: <s>Nandin</s>, the lord, in ancient times conquered death through the <s>Rudrādhyāya</s>. (LiP 2.27.274)
The <s>asura</s> named <s>Tāraka</s>, of great strength, was formerly consecrated;

children.text: vidyunmālī hiraṇyākṣo viṣṇunā vai vinirjitaḥ // LiP_2,27.275 //
children.translated_text: <s>Vidyunmālī</s> and <s>Hiraṇyākṣa</s> were defeated by <s>Viṣṇu</s>. (LiP 2.27.275)
The <s>daitya</s> <s>Hiraṇyakaśipu</s> was formerly slain by <s>Nṛsiṃha</s>.

children.text: skandena tārakādyāśca kauśikyā ca purāṃbayā // LiP_2,27.276 //
children.translated_text: <s>Tāraka</s> and others by <s>Skanda</s>, and by <s>Kauśikī</s> the ancient <s>Ambā</s>. (LiP 2.27.276)
The two sons of <s>Sunda</s> and <s>Upasunda</s>, honored by the king of <s>daityas</s>, were vanquished,
and <s>Vasudeva</s> and <s>Sudeva</s> were slain by her who had accomplished her purpose. (LiP 2.27.277)
Through the bathing rite devised by <s>Brahmā</s> according to rule,
in the war between gods and <s>asuras</s>, the sons of <s>Diti</s> were defeated by the blameless gods. (LiP 2.27.278)
Having been bathed thus by all kings and also by other <s>brāhmaṇas</s>,

children.text: prāptāśca siddhayo divyānātra kāryā vicāraṇā // LiP_2,27.279 //
children.translated_text: divine <s>siddhis</s> (perfections) were obtained — there should be no doubt about this. (LiP 2.27.279)
Oh, the greatness of consecration (<s>abhiṣeka</s>)! Oh, the pure, well-spoken [teaching]!
By one thus consecrated, death has been conquered by the perfected ones! (LiP 2.27.280)
Whatever sin has been accumulated over hundreds of crores of <s>kalpas</s> —

children.text: snātvaivaṃ mucyate rājā sarvapāpairna saṃśayaḥ // LiP_2,27.281 //
children.translated_text: having bathed thus, the king is freed from all sins, without doubt. (LiP 2.27.281)
The king is freed from diseases — consumption, leprosy, and the like;

children.text: sa nityaṃ vijayī bhūtvā putrapautrādibhiryutaḥ // LiP_2,27.282 //
children.translated_text: ever victorious, endowed with sons, grandsons, and the like, (LiP 2.27.282)
possessing the affection of the people, like another king of the gods,
he rejoices, free from sin, with his beloved, devoted to <s>dharma</s>. (LiP 2.27.283)
Only an indication has been told of the supremely beautiful fruit,
for the benefit of kings, O <s>Svāyambhuva</s>, by me. (LiP 2.27.284)
Thus ends the twenty-seventh chapter, named 'The Procedure of Consecration' (<s>abhiṣekavidhi</s>), in the <s>Uttarabhāga</s> of the glorious <s>Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa</s>.
<s>Sūta</s> said:
Having bathed and saluted the god, the god of gods, the lord of <s>Umā</s>,
with divine vision [beholding] <s>Rudrā</s>, the blue-and-red <s>Īśvara</s>, (LiP 2.28.1)
having seen the boon-granting <s>Śaṅkara</s>, he praised [Him] with the <s>Rudrādhyāya</s>.

children.text: devo 'pi tuṣṭyā nirvāṇaṃ rājyānte karmaṇaiva tu // LiP_2,28.2 //
children.translated_text: The god too, pleased, [promised] liberation (<s>nirvāṇa</s>) at the end of his reign through his deeds. (LiP 2.28.2)
Having said 'It shall be yours' just once, He disappeared right there.
<s>Svāyambhuva</s> <s>Manu</s>, having saluted the god bearing the bull-banner, (LiP 2.28.3)
He ascended the great <s>Meru</s>, like the Lord [mounting] His great bull.
There he beheld the God, golden in radiance, endowed with the sovereignty of <s>yoga</s>, (LiP 2,28.4)
<s>Sanatkumāra</s>, the boon-granter, the son of <s>Brahmā</s>,
and bowed to the boon-granter, devoted to <s>Brahman</s>, of the form of <s>Brahman</s>. (LiP 2,28.5)
With palms joined in salutation, the one of great splendor praised [him].

children.text: so 'pi dṛṣṭvā manuṃ devo hṛṣṭaromābhavanmuniḥ // LiP_2,28.6 //
children.translated_text: And he [<s>Sanatkumāra</s>], upon seeing <s>Manu</s>, the divine sage, became thrilled with joy. (LiP 2,28.6)
<s>Sanatkumāra</s> spoke thus, with compassion, O treasury of compassion.
<s>Sanatkumāra</s> said:
Having been seen by the Lord of all, the peaceful <s>Śaṅkara</s>, the blue-and-red <s>Nīlalohita</s>, (LiP 2,28.7)
having received consecration, you have arrived — speak if you wish to say anything.

children.text: tasya tadvacanaṃ śrutvā praṇipatya kṛtāñjaliḥ // LiP_2,28.8 //
children.translated_text: Having heard his words, bowing down with palms joined, (LiP 2,28.8)
he submitted [the question]: 'How is liberation (<s>nirvṛti</s>) [attained] through action, O Lord?'

children.text: vaktumarhasi cāsmākaṃ karmaṇā kevalena ca // LiP_2,28.9 //
children.translated_text: 'Please tell us — is it through action alone, (LiP 2,28.9)

children.text: jñānena nirvṛtiḥ siddhā vibho miśreṇa vā kkacit /
children.translated_text: or is liberation accomplished through knowledge, or perhaps through a combination of both, O Lord?'

children.text: atha tasya vacaḥ śrutvā śrutisāravidāṃ nidhiḥ // LiP_2,28.10 //
children.translated_text: Then, having heard his words, the treasure-house of those who know the essence of <s>Śruti</s>, (LiP 2,28.10)
the blessed <s>Sanatkumāra</s> [said]: 'Through action, liberation [comes] gradually;

children.text: miśreṇa ca kramādeva kṣaṇājjñānena vai mune // LiP_2,28.11 //
children.translated_text: through a combination as well, gradually; but through knowledge, instantaneously, O sage. (LiP 2,28.11)
Formerly, through pride, I attained camel-hood, [as a servant] of Lord <s>Nandin</s>;
by [his] curse, and then by [his] grace — having worshipped <s>Śiva</s>, <s>Śaṅkara</s>, (LiP 2,28.12)
by the grace of <s>Nandin</s>, through action alone, I became [his] son.
Having heard of the supreme, divine state, I attained that condition. (LiP 2,28.13)
Through the method of worshipping <s>Śiva</s>, through <s>Śiva-dharma</s>, and not otherwise.',

children.text: rājñāṃ ṣoḍaśadānāni nandinā kathitāni ca // LiP_2,28.14 //
children.translated_text: The sixteen gifts for kings were described by <s>Nandin</s>, (LiP 2,28.14)
for the attainment of <s>dharma</s>, <s>kāma</s>, <s>artha</s>, and liberation — through action alone, by the great soul.
The <s>tulā</s> (balance) ascension and others — hear them as they truly are. (LiP 2,28.15)
At times such as eclipses, in auspicious places, beautifully,
a pavilion (<s>maṇḍapa</s>) and a summit (<s>kūṭa</s>) [should be made], of twenty hand-measures in dimension. (LiP 2,28.16)
Or of eighteen hand-measures, or of one <s>kalā</s>-hand-measure,

children.text: kṛtvā vediṃ tathā madhye navahastapramāṇataḥ // LiP_2,28.17 //
children.translated_text: having constructed an altar (<s>vedi</s>) in the center, of nine hand-measures in dimension. (LiP 2,28.17)

children.text: aṣṭahastena vā kāryā saptahastena vā punaḥ /
children.translated_text: It should be made of eight hand-measures, or again of seven hand-measures;

children.text: dvihastā sārdhahastā vā vedikā cātiśobhanā // LiP_2,28.18 //
children.translated_text: the altar-platform, of two or one-and-a-half hand-measures, most beautiful, (LiP 2,28.18)
furnished with twelve pillars, delightfully charming, with a gallery.

children.text: parito nava kuṇḍāni caturasrāṇi kārayet // LiP_2,28.19 //
children.translated_text: Nine fire-pits should be made all around, square-shaped. (LiP 2,28.19)
Between [the directions of] <s>Indra</s> and <s>Īśāna</s>, the principal [pit], O daughter of <s>Brahmā</s>;

children.text: athavā caturasraṃ ca yonyākāramataḥ param // LiP_2,28.20 //
children.translated_text: or square-shaped, or of yoni-form, beyond that. (LiP 2,28.20)
For women, O best of Brahmins, the fire-pits should be made in yoni-shape.

children.text: ardhacandraṃ trikoṇaṃ ca vartulaṃ kuṇḍameva ca // LiP_2,28.21 //
children.translated_text: Half-moon, triangular, circular pit, (LiP 2,28.21)
hexagonal, or in all [cases] triangular, lotus-shaped,

children.text: aṣṭāsraṃ sarvamāne tu sthaṇḍilaṃ kevalaṃ tu vā // LiP_2,28.22 //
children.translated_text: octagonal — in all measures; or a bare ground-altar (<s>sthaṇḍila</s>) alone. (LiP 2,28.22)
Furnished with four doors, adorned with four gateways,
accompanied by the eight directional elephants, encircled with garlands of <s>darbha</s> grass. (LiP 2,28.23)
Furnished with the eight auspicious objects, adorned above with a canopy.
The balance-pillars and the trees there [should be] of <s>bilva</s> (wood-apple) and such especially. (LiP 2,28.24)
<s>Bilva</s>, <s>aśvattha</s> (fig), <s>palāśa</s> (flame-of-the-forest) and others, or of <s>khadira</s> (acacia) alone —

children.text: yena staṃbhaḥ kṛtaḥ pūrvaṃ tena sarvaṃ tu kārayet // LiP_2,28.25 //
children.translated_text: whatever wood the pillar is first made of, with that same [wood] everything should be fashioned. (LiP 2,28.25)
Or by the mixed method, or one may construct [it] with bamboo.
Of eight hand-measures in dimension, and two hand-measures [additional] — (LiP 2,28.26)
the circumference of the balance-pillar, unwound, is considered to be three times [the diameter].

children.text: dvyaṅgulena vihīnaṃ tu suvṛttaṃ nirvraṇaṃ tathā // LiP_2,28.27 //
children.translated_text: Reduced by two finger-breadths, well-rounded, and without blemish. (LiP 2,28.27)
The interval between both [pillars], O king, is said to be six hand-measures.
Of the two [pillars] with four hand-measures' interval between the pillars — (LiP 2,28.28)
the interval above the pillars is to be known as six [hand-measures].
The width is one span; the cross-bar is that much beyond. (LiP 2,28.29)
The upper beam, matching the proportions of the pillars,
endowed with thirty-six <s>mātrā</s>-measures, the arm (<s>vyāyāma</s>) that constitutes the balance. (LiP 2,28.30)
The cross-bar of eight <s>mātrā</s>-measures, endowed with a barley-grain panel;
the hub of thirty-six <s>mātrā</s>-measures, well-rounded, auspicious, from construction. (LiP 2,28.31)

children.text: agre mūle ca madhye ca hemapaṭṭena bandayet /
children.translated_text: At the tip, base, and middle, one should bind with gold strips.
In the middle of the strip, three suspension-hooks should be made. (LiP 2,28.32)
The three suspension-hooks should be made of copper,

children.text: āreṇa vā prakartavyamāyasaṃ naiva kārayet // LiP_2,28.33 //
children.translated_text: or of brass; but they should never be made of iron. (LiP 2,28.33)
In the middle, an upward-facing [hook] should be made — the most beautiful suspension;
with ropes, at the tip of the gateway, one should bind according to the rule. (LiP 2,28.34)
A single tongue (pointer) in the middle of the balance, made of silver, is prescribed.

children.text: uttarasya ca madhye ca śaṅkuṃ dṛḍhamanuttamam // LiP_2,28.35 //
children.translated_text: In the middle of the upper [beam], a strong, excellent peg [should be fixed]. (LiP 2,28.35)
Having covered [it] above with a canopy, one should firmly set [it] properly.
On the peg, one should make a ring provided with a hole, O sage. (LiP 2,28.36)
In the middle of the balance, with a canopy, on the balance's suspension,
by means of the ring, one should attach the earring-[shaped] suspension. (LiP 2,28.37)
Very firmly, in the middle of the balance, of nine finger-breadths' measure,
the width of the strip itself, of five <s>mātrā</s>-measures. (LiP 2,28.38)
Two other very firm globes should be made of auspicious material.
Below the hanging-baskets, they should be made, five <s>prādeśa</s>-measures wide,

children.text: sahasreṇa tu kartavyau palānāṃ dhārakāvubhau // LiP_2,28.39 //
children.translated_text: both capable of bearing a thousand <s>palas</s> (weight-units). (LiP 2,28.39)
Or one should make [them] with eight hundred <s>palas</s>, or indeed six hundred <s>palas</s>.
The breadth of the middle should be made as four <s>tāla</s>-measures. (LiP 2,28.40)
Three-and-a-half <s>tāla</s>-measures is prescribed for the breadth of the water-vessel.
One should bind the five-vessel [apparatus] — [each] of three <s>mātrā</s>-measures, six [vessels] are declared. (LiP 2,28.41)
Furnished with four openings, each opening of one finger-breadth measure,
accompanied by rings, endowed with pure white [material]. (LiP 2,28.42)
On each ring, a chain-circle should be made;
the chain-bearing ring should be joined with the suspension-hook. (LiP 2,28.43)
One <s>prādeśa</s> or four <s>mātrā</s>-measures — one should suspend [it] from the ground.

children.text: ghaṭau puruṣamātrau tu kartavyau śobhanāvubhau // LiP_2,28.44 //
children.translated_text: Two pots, each of one person's height, should be made, both beautiful. (LiP 2,28.44)

children.text: tau vālukābhiḥ saṃpūrya śivaṃ tatra viniḥkṣipet /
children.translated_text: Having filled those with sand, one should place a [<s>Śiva</s>-image] there.
They should be placed with effort in a pit of two hand-measures depth. (LiP 2,28.45)
The learned one should fill [the pit] completely with sand all around,

children.text: yena niścalatāṃ gacchettena mārgeṇa kārayet // LiP_2,28.46 //
children.translated_text: so that immobility is achieved — by that method one should construct [it]. (LiP 2,28.46)
Hear the supremely secret [arrangement of] the circle atop the altar.
Furnished with eight finger-breadths [of decoration], adorned with auspicious sprouts. (LiP 2,28.47)
Strewn with fruits and flowers, accompanied by incense and lamps,
it should be made in the middle of the altar, resembling the interior of a mirror. (LiP 2,28.48)
One should first draw a <s>maṇḍala</s>, furnished with four doors,
endowed with beauty and secondary adornments, having a pericarp and filaments. (LiP 2,28.49)
Endowed with the [proper] color and type, one should make [it] of five colors.

children.text: vajraṃ prāgantare bhāge āgneyyāṃ śaktimujjvalām // LiP_2,28.50 //
children.translated_text: A <s>vajra</s> (thunderbolt) in the eastern intermediate sector; in the southeast, a blazing <s>śakti</s> (spear). (LiP 2,28.50)
One should draw a staff (<s>daṇḍa</s>) in the south; in the southwest, one should draw a sword.

children.text: pāśaśca vāruṇe lekhyo dhvajaṃ vai vāyugocare // LiP_2,28.51 //
children.translated_text: A noose (<s>pāśa</s>) should be drawn in the west; a banner (<s>dhvaja</s>) in the domain of <s>Vāyu</s> (northwest). (LiP 2,28.51)

children.text: kauberyāṃ tu gadā lekhyā aiśānyāṃ śūlamālikhet /
children.translated_text: In the north (<s>Kubera</s>'s quarter), a mace (<s>gadā</s>) should be drawn; in the northeast, one should draw a trident.

children.text: śūlasya vāmadeśena cakraṃ padmaṃ tu dakṣiṇe // LiP_2,28.52 //
children.translated_text: To the left of the trident, a discus (<s>cakra</s>); a lotus to the right. (LiP 2,28.52)
Having thus drawn [the <s>maṇḍala</s>], one should then perform the fire-offering rites.

children.text: pradhānahomaṃ gāyatryā svāhā śakraāya vahneye // LiP_2,28.53 //
children.translated_text: The principal <s>homa</s> with the <s>Gāyatrī</s>, [ending] '<s>Svāhā</s>' — for <s>Śakra</s> (Indra) in the fire [direction], (LiP 2,28.53)
for <s>Yama</s>, for the lord of the <s>Rākṣasas</s>, for <s>Varuṇa</s>, for <s>Vāyu</s>,
for <s>Kubera</s>, for <s>Īśvara</s>, and then for <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and again for <s>Brahmā</s>. (LiP 2,28.54)
Ending with '<s>Svāhā</s>,' with <s>Praṇava</s> alone, the offering should be made according to the rule,
with the fire-formula of one's own [Vedic] branch, accompanied by [the mantras] '<s>Jaya</s>' and so forth. (LiP 2,28.55)
All rites ending with the <s>sviṣṭakṛt</s> offering should then be performed according to the rule.
In all <s>homas</s> and in the preliminary offering, fuel-sticks of <s>palāśa</s> (butea) are prescribed,
twenty-one in number — one should offer with this mantra. (LiP 2,28.56)

children.text: ayantaidhmaātmājātavedastene dhyasvavardhasvaceddhavardhayacāsmānprajayāpaśubhirbrahmavarcasenānnādyenasamedhayasvāhā bhūḥ svāhā bhuvaḥsvāhā svaḥ svāhā bhūrbhuvaḥ svastathaiva ca /
children.translated_text: 'This fuel-stick, O self-born <s>Jātavedas</s>, by it may you increase; increase and nourish us with progeny, with cattle, with Brahminical splendor, with food. <s>Svāhā</s>. <s>Bhūḥ Svāhā</s>. <s>Bhuvaḥ Svāhā</s>. <s>Svaḥ Svāhā</s>. <s>Bhūr Bhuvaḥ Svaḥ</s>' — and likewise.
The fuel-offering, with the oblation (<s>caru</s>), and of ghee — in proper sequence.

children.text: śuklānnapāyasaṃ caiva mudgānnaṃ caravaḥ smṛtāḥ // LiP_2,28.57 //
children.translated_text: White rice-pudding (<s>pāyasa</s>) and green-gram (<s>mudga</s>) food — these are the [types of] oblations (<s>caru</s>). (LiP 2,28.57)

children.text: sahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tu vā // LiP_2,28.58 //
children.translated_text: A thousand [oblations], or half that, or one hundred and eight. (LiP 2,28.58)

children.text:
agna āyūṃṣi pavasa āsuvorjamiṣaṃ ca naḥ /
arobādhasvaducchanām /
agnirṛṣiḥ pavamānaḥ pāñcajanyaḥ purohitaḥ /
tamīmahe mahāgayam /
agne pavasva svapā asme varcaḥ suvīryam /
dadhadrayiṃ mayi poṣam /
prajāpate na tvadetānyanyo viśvājātāni paritā babhūva /
children.translated_text: 'O <s>Prajāpati</s>, no other than you has encompassed all these born beings;

children.text: yatkāmāste juhumastanno astu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām /
children.translated_text: whatever desires we offer — may those be ours; may we be lords of wealth.'
With the <s>Gāyatrī</s> for the principal [deity], and the fuel-offering likewise,

children.text: caruṇā ca tathājyasya śakradīnāṃ ca homayet // LiP_2,28.59 //
children.translated_text: with the oblation (<s>caru</s>) and of ghee — one should offer for <s>Śakra</s> (Indra) and the others. (LiP 2,28.59)

'O <s>Agni</s>, purify our lifespans; bestow upon us vitality, nourishment, and food; ward off evil from us. / <s>Agni</s> is the <s>Ṛṣi</s>; <s>Pavamāna</s> of the five peoples is the priest. / Him we praise, the great chanter. / O <s>Agni</s>, purify — [give] to us good fortune, splendor, and heroic vigor; / bestowing wealth and prosperity upon me.'

children.text: vajrādīnāṃ ca hotavyaṃ sahasrārdhaṃ tataḥ kramāt /
children.translated_text: For the <s>vajra</s> and other [weapons], half a thousand should be offered, in sequence.

children.text: brahma jajñeti mantreṇa brahmaṇe viṣṇave punaḥ // LiP_2,28.60 //
children.translated_text: With the mantra '<s>Brahma jajña</s>' (<s>Brahman</s> was born), for <s>Brahmā</s>; and again for <s>Viṣṇu</s>: (LiP 2,28.60)
'We know <s>Nārāyaṇa</s>; we meditate on <s>Vāsudeva</s>;
may <s>Viṣṇu</s> inspire us.'
This distinction has been described — the most beautiful path of <s>homa</s>.
With <s>dūrvā</s> grass mixed with milk, twenty-five [offerings], each separately. (LiP 2,28.61)
'We worship the three-eyed one (<s>Tryambaka</s>), the fragrant, the increaser of nourishment;

children.text: urvārukam iva bandhanān mṛtyormukṣayi māmṛtāt // LiP_2,28.62 //
children.translated_text: like a cucumber from its stem, may [He] release me from death, not from immortality.' (LiP 2,28.62)
This <s>dūrvā</s>-offering is praised, and the <s>Vāsu</s>-offering in every way.
The expiation (<s>prāyaścitta</s>) [is offered] with the <s>Aghora</s> [mantra], with ghee, one hundred times one hundred. (LiP 2,28.63)

children.text: brahmāṇaṃ dakṣiṇe vāme viṣṇuṃ viśvaguruṃ śivam /
children.translated_text: <s>Brahmā</s> on the right; <s>Viṣṇu</s> on the left; <s>Śiva</s>, the teacher of the universe,
in the center with the Goddess — one should know [this], surrounded by the host of <s>Indra</s> and others. (LiP 2,28.64)

children.text: ādityaṃ bhāskaraṃ bhānuṃ raviṃ devaṃ divākaram /
children.translated_text: <s>Āditya</s>, <s>Bhāskara</s>, <s>Bhānu</s>, <s>Ravi</s>, <s>Deva</s>, <s>Divākara</s>,

children.text: uṣāṃ prabhāṃ tathā prajñāṃ saṃdhyāṃ sāvitrimeva ca // LiP_2,28.65 //
children.translated_text: <s>Uṣā</s>, <s>Prabhā</s>, <s>Prajñā</s>, <s>Sandhyā</s>, and <s>Sāvitrī</s> — (LiP 2,28.65)
with the fivefold method, to <s>Khakholka</s>, the great soul,

children.text: viṣṭarāṃ subhagāṃ caiva vardhanīṃ ca pradakṣiṇām // LiP_2,28.66 //
children.translated_text: the spreading-seat (<s>viṣṭara</s>), the auspicious one (<s>subhagā</s>), the increasing one (<s>vardhanī</s>), and the circumambulating one (<s>pradakṣiṇā</s>), (LiP 2,28.66)

children.text: āpyāyanīṃ ca saṃpūjya devī padmāsane ravim /
children.translated_text: and the nourishing one (<s>āpyāyanī</s>) — having worshipped the Goddess on the lotus-seat, the sun.

children.text: prabhūtaṃ vātha kartavyaṃ vimalaṃ dakṣiṇe tathā // LiP_2,28.67 //
children.translated_text: The abundant [offering] should be made — the pure one on the south, (LiP 2,28.67)

children.text: sāraṃ paścimabhāge ca ārādhyaṃ cottare yajet /
children.translated_text: the essential on the western side; on the north one should worship <s>Ārādhya</s> (the worthy one).
In the center, one should know <s>Sukha</s> (bliss); on the filaments, in proper sequence: (LiP 2,28.68)

children.text: dīptāṃ sūkṣmāṃ jayāṃ bhadrāṃ vibhūtiṃ vimalāṃ kramāt /
children.translated_text: <s>Dīptā</s> (radiant), <s>Sūkṣmā</s> (subtle), <s>Jayā</s> (victorious), <s>Bhadrā</s> (auspicious), <s>Vibhūti</s> (glory), <s>Vimalā</s> (pure), in order,

children.text: amoghāṃ vidyutāṃ caiva madhyataḥ sarvatomukhīm // LiP_2,28.69 //
children.translated_text: <s>Amoghā</s> (unfailing), <s>Vidyutā</s> (lightning) — and in the center, <s>Sarvatomukhī</s> (all-facing). (LiP 2,28.69)
<s>Soma</s> (Moon), <s>Aṅgāraka</s> (Mars), <s>Budha</s> (Mercury), <s>Guru</s> (Jupiter), in sequence,

children.text: bhārgavaṃ ca tathā mandaṃ rāhuṃ ketuṃ tathaiva ca // LiP_2,28.70 //
children.translated_text: <s>Bhārgava</s> (Venus), <s>Manda</s> (Saturn), <s>Rāhu</s>, and <s>Ketu</s> likewise — (LiP 2,28.70)
one should worship, offer fire-oblations to the God, and especially give [gifts].
One should feed yogins there, those who have mastered the principles of <s>Śiva</s> alone, (LiP 2,28.71)
endowed with divine learning — having thus performed the elaborate ritual.
While the <s>homa</s> is proceeding, in the eastern and other directions and in the center, (LiP 2,28.72)
One should cause the king to ascend according to the rule, with the <s>Rudrādhyāya</s>,
and keep the king there for one <s>ghaṭikā</s> (24 minutes), according to the rule. (LiP 2,28.73)
The sacrificer should recite the mantra called the <s>Rudra-Gāyatrī</s>;
for half a <s>ghaṭikā</s> or half of that — then he should begin the seating [ceremony]. (LiP 2,28.74)
The wise one, holding <s>kuśa</s> grass in hand, focused, looking toward the west;
and the king, adorned with ornaments, bearing a sword and shield, (LiP 2,28.75)
with '<s>svasti</s>' blessings at the beginning and especially at the end —
the '<s>puṇyāha</s>' (auspicious day) declaration should be performed by brahmins versed in the <s>Vedas</s> and <s>Vedāṅgas</s>. (LiP 2,28.76)
With cries of 'Victory!' and auspicious [words], with splendid <s>Brahma</s>-chanting,
with dancing, music, and songs — accompanied by all splendor. (LiP 2,28.77)
In one's own [area], in the lunar directional quarter, one should cast gold there.

children.text: tulādhārau samau vṛttau tulābhāraḥ sadā bhavet // LiP_2,28.78 //
children.translated_text: The balance-holders should be even and round; the balance-weight should always be [accurate]. (LiP 2,28.78)
More than a hundred <s>niṣkas</s> [of gold] is the best; half that is the middle;

children.text: tasyārdhaṃ ca kaniṣṭhaṃ syāttrividhaṃ tatra kalpitam // LiP_2,28.79 //
children.translated_text: half of that is the lowest — three grades are prescribed. (LiP 2,28.79)
A pair of garments, a turban, earrings, a neck ornament,
a finger ring, and a wrist ornament — (LiP 2,28.80)
all these, at the commencement of the <s>dharma</s>-ceremony,
should be given to one observing the <s>Pāśupata</s> vow, whose body is smeared with ash. (LiP 2,28.81)
All the aforementioned ornaments, with turban and garments,
the wise one should give to the officiants, along with a covering cloth. (LiP 2,28.82)

children.text: dakṣiṇāṃ ca śataṃ sārdhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā pradāpayet /
children.translated_text: A fee of one hundred and fifty [<s>niṣkas</s>], or half that, should be given;

children.text: yogināṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ pṛthaṅniṣkaṃ pradāpayet // LiP_2,28.83 //
children.translated_text: and to each of all the <s>yogins</s>, one <s>niṣka</s> should be given separately. (LiP 2,28.83)
The divine sacrificial implements should be given to the <s>ācārya</s>;

children.text: itareṣāṃ yatīnāṃ tu pṛthaṅniṣkaṃ pradāpayet // LiP_2,28.84 //
children.translated_text: and to the other ascetics, one <s>niṣka</s> each should be given. (LiP 2,28.84)
The gold from the balance-weighing should be offered to <s>Śiva</s>.

children.text: prāsādaṃ maṇḍapaṃ caiva prākāraṃ bhūṣaṇaṃ tathā // LiP_2,28.85 //
children.translated_text: A temple, a pavilion, a surrounding wall, ornaments, (LiP 2,28.85)

children.text: suvarṇapuṣpaṃ paṭahaṃ khaḍgaṃ vai kośameva ca /
children.translated_text: golden flowers, a drum, a sword, and a treasury —

children.text: kṛtvā dattvā śivāyātha kiñciccheṣaṃ ca buddhimān // LiP_2,28.86 //
children.translated_text: having made and given [these] to <s>Śiva</s>, the wise one [should give] whatever remains (LiP 2,28.86)
to the teachers, especially to those whose bodies are smeared with ash.

children.text: payasā vātha dadhnā vā sarvadravyairathāpi vā /
children.translated_text: With milk, or curds, or with all substances,

children.text: brahmakūrcena vā devaṃ pañcagavyena cavā punaḥ // LiP_2,28.87 //
children.translated_text: or with the <s>brahmakūrca</s> (five-kuśa bundle), or again with the five products of the cow (<s>pañcagavya</s>), (LiP 2,28.87)
one should bathe the Supreme Lord with a thousand vessels there,
or with pure ghee alone, the God of Gods, the Lord of <s>Umā</s>. (LiP 2,28.88)

children.text: payasā vātha dadhnā vā sarvadravyairathāpi vā /
children.translated_text: With milk, or curds, or with all substances,

children.text: brahmakūrcena vā devaṃ pañcagavyena vā punaḥ // LiP_2,28.89 //
children.translated_text: or with the <s>brahmakūrca</s>, or again with the five products of the cow. (LiP 2,28.89)

children.text: gāyatryā caiva gomūtraṃ gomayaṃ praṇavena vā /
children.translated_text: With the <s>Gāyatrī</s> [one should pour] cow's urine; with <s>praṇava</s>, cow dung;

children.text: āpyāyasveti vai kṣīraṃ dadhikraāvṇoti vai dadhi // LiP_2,28.90 //
children.translated_text: '<s>Āpyāyasva</s>' — [with this,] milk; '<s>Dadhikrāvṇa</s>' — [with this,] curds. (LiP 2,28.90)
'<s>Tejosi</s>' — [with this,] ghee; with the <s>Īśāna</s> mantra one should consecrate;
'<s>Devasyatva</s>' — [with this,] the God of Gods, with a vessel of <s>kuśa</s>-water. (LiP 2,28.91)
Or with the <s>Rudrādhyāya</s>, one should bathe the Supreme Lord completely.
A thousand vessels for <s>Śambhu</s>, and with a thousand names — (LiP 2,28.92)
those told by <s>Viṣṇu</s>, or those told by <s>Taṇḍin</s>,
or those proclaimed by the chief sage <s>Dakṣa</s>. (LiP 2,28.93)
The great worship should be performed for <s>Mahādeva</s> with devotion.

children.text: śivārcakāya dātavyā dakṣiṇā svaguroḥ sadā // LiP_2,28.94 //
children.translated_text: The fee should always be given to the <s>Śiva</s>-worshipper and one's own teacher. (LiP 2,28.94)

children.text: dehārṇavaṃ ca sarveṣāṃ dakṣiṇā ca yatākramam /
children.translated_text: And the body-ocean [offering] for all, and the fee in proper order.
The destitute, the blind, the wretched, children, the old, the lean, and the sick — (LiP 2,28.95)
one should feed them according to the rule and also give fees. (LiP 2,28.96)
Thus ends the twenty-eighth chapter of the <s>Uttarabhāga</s> of the glorious <s>Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa</s>, entitled 'The Rule of the <s>Tulāpuruṣa</s> Gift.'
<s>Sanatkumāra</s> said:

children.text: tulā te kathitā hyeṣā ādyā sāmānyarūpiṇī /
children.translated_text: This first and general balance[-gift] has been described to you.
I shall describe the second — the <s>Hiraṇyagarbha</s> (Golden Womb), the bestower of all attainments. (LiP 2,29.1)
The lower vessel [is made] with a thousand [<s>niṣkas</s>] of gold;
the upper vessel with half that; the opening just large enough for a person to enter. (LiP 2,29.2)
One should make it golden and auspicious, furnished with all ornaments.
In the lower vessel, one should invoke the Goddess endowed with the three <s>guṇas</s>. (LiP 2,29.3)
The Goddess of twenty-four [principles], embodying <s>Brahmā</s>, <s>Viṣṇu</s>, and <s>Agni</s>;
in the upper vessel, the Lord of <s>Umā</s>, the twenty-sixth, beyond the <s>guṇas</s>. (LiP 2,29.4)
One should meditate on the self, the <s>Puruṣa</s>, the twenty-fifth, the firstborn.
In the midst of the previously described place, on the altar-platform, in the <s>maṇḍala</s>, (LiP 2,29.5)
one should place [the vessel] amid rice, having brought it, and wrap with nine cloths.
Having anointed with a paste of black beans, one should worship with the five substances. (LiP 2,29.6)
With <s>Īśāna</s> and the other [mantras], one should worship with the five, as is proper.
<s>Śiva</s>-worship and oblation, as before, in proper sequence. (LiP 2,29.7)
Having recited the <s>Devī-Gāyatrī</s>, one should enter [the vessel] oneself, facing east.

children.text: vidhinaiva tu saṃpādya garbhādhānādikāṃ kriyām // LiP_2,29.8 //
children.translated_text: Having performed the rite of <s>garbhādhāna</s> (embryo-placing) and the like, according to the rule, (LiP 2,29.8)
the foremost brahmin should perform [the rites] by the sixteen-step method, according to the rule.

children.text: dūrvākuraistu kartavyā secanā dakṣiṇe puṭe // LiP_2,29.9 //
children.translated_text: The sprinkling should be done with shoots of <s>dūrvā</s> grass in the right [hand]. (LiP 2,29.9)
Together with <s>udumbara</s> (fig) fruits, with twenty-one [sprinklings of] <s>kuśa</s>-water;
in the northeast, one should perform the <s>sīmantakarma</s> (parting-ceremony). (LiP 2,29.10)
One should raise up a maiden, having made [her] beautiful with thirty <s>niṣkas</s> [of gold],

children.text: alaṅkṛtya tathā hutvā śivāya vinivedayet // LiP_2,29.11 //
children.translated_text: adorned, and having offered oblation, one should present [her] to <s>Śiva</s>. (LiP 2,29.11)
At the <s>annaprāśana</s> (first-feeding) [ceremony], the wise one should feed [people] with milk-pudding and the like.

children.text: evaṃ viśvajitāntā vai garbhādhānādikāḥ kriyāḥ // LiP_2,29.12 //
children.translated_text: Thus, the rites from <s>garbhādhāna</s> up to <s>viśvajit</s> (world-conquering sacrifice) — (LiP 2,29.12)
should be performed with the <s>śakti</s>-seed [mantra] by brahmins versed in the <s>Vedas</s>.
All the rest should be performed according to the rule, as in the balance-gold [ceremony]. (LiP 2,29.13)
Thus ends the twenty-ninth chapter of the <s>Uttarabhāga</s> of the glorious <s>Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa</s>.
<s>Sanatkumāra</s> said:
Now I shall describe the excellent <s>Tilaparvata</s> (Sesame Mountain).

children.text: pūrvoktasthānakāle tu kṛtvā saṃpūjya yatnataḥ // LiP_2,30.1 //
children.translated_text: At the previously stated place and time, having performed [the rites] and worshipped with effort: (LiP 2,30.1)

children.text: susame bhūtale ramye vedinā ca vivarjite /
children.translated_text: On level, pleasant ground, free from an altar,

children.text: daśatālapramāṇaena daṇḍaṃ saṃsthāpya vai mune // LiP_2,30.2 //
children.translated_text: having set up a pole ten <s>tālas</s> in height, O sage, (LiP 2,30.2)
having sprinkled with water, one should then cast sesame upon it.
The foremost brahmin should sprinkle that area with <s>pañcagavya</s>. (LiP 2,30.3)
The learned one should fashion a <s>maṇḍala</s> as before, well-arranged on all sides.
Having established [it] with nine cloths, strewn with beautiful flowers, (LiP 2,30.4)
the heaping should be done there with loads (<s>bhāras</s>) of sesame especially.
The height of a <s>daṇḍa</s> (staff) and a <s>prādeśa</s> (span) is proclaimed as the best. (LiP 2,30.5)
Four <s>aṅgulas</s> less is the middle, O bulls among sages.

children.text: daṇḍatulyaṃ kaniṣṭhaṃ syāddaṇḍahīnaṃ na kārayet // LiP_2,30.6 //
children.translated_text: Equal to a <s>daṇḍa</s> is the lowest — less than a <s>daṇḍa</s> should not be made. (LiP 2,30.6)
Having wrapped with nine cloths, one should worship all around in sequence.
Having placed <s>Sadya</s>[ojāta] and the other [mantras], one should worship according to the rule. (LiP 2,30.7)

children.text: aṣṭadikṣu ca kartavyāḥ pūrvoktā mūrtayaḥ kramāt /
children.translated_text: The previously described forms should be made in the eight directions, in order,
each with three <s>niṣkas</s> of gold, fashioned in sequence. (LiP 2,30.8)
The fee should be given according to the rule, as in the balance-gift.
The oblation is as previously described, O best of sages. (LiP 2,30.9)
One should worship the God of Gods, surrounded by the world-guardians,
established in the midst of the sesame mountain, in the form of the sesame mountain. (LiP 2,30.10)
<s>Śiva</s>-worship should be performed with a thousand vessels and the like.
One should reveal the God of Gods, the Lord of <s>Umā</s>, established amid the sesame. (LiP 2,30.11)
Having worshipped according to the rule, one should then dismiss [the deities] in sequence.
The sesame mountain should be given to a learned, poor brahmin. (LiP 2,30.12)

children.text: evaṃ tilanagaḥ proktaḥ sarvasmādadhikaḥ paraḥ // LiP_2,30.13 //
children.translated_text: Thus has been described the sesame mountain — the supreme [gift], greater than all others. (LiP 2,30.13)

children.text: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge tilaparvatadānaṃ nāma triṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
children.translated_text: Thus ends the thirtieth chapter of the <s>Uttarabhāga</s> of the glorious <s>Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa</s>, entitled 'The Gift of the Sesame Mountain.'
<s>Sanatkumāra</s> said:
Now [I shall describe] another mountain — subtle, requiring few materials, [yet] of great fruit.
When only materials are available, at the proper time, the middle [grade] is prescribed. (LiP 2,31.1)
On ground smeared with cow dung, having spread cloths,
in the midst of that, the wise one should cast three loads of sesame, auspicious. (LiP 2,31.2)
One should make an eight-petaled lotus, with pericarp and filaments.

children.text: daśaniṣkeṇa tatkāryaṃ tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ // LiP_2,31.3 //
children.translated_text: It should be made with ten <s>niṣkas</s> [of gold], or with half of half of that. (LiP 2,31.3)
One should place the lotus amid the sesame; in the midst of the lotus, <s>Maheśvara</s>.
Having worshipped the god according to the rule, one should worship <s>Vāmā</s> and the others. (LiP 2,31.4)
The <s>śakti</s>-forms should be made with gold, three <s>niṣkas</s> each.
The placement should be done all around, beginning with the <s>Vighneśas</s> (Gaṇeśa). (LiP 2,31.5)
The <s>Vighneśas</s> too should be made with the previously described measure of gold.

children.text: tān abhyarcya vidhānena gandhapūṣpādibhiḥ kramāt // LiP_2,31.6 //
children.translated_text: Having worshipped them according to the rule, with fragrance, flowers, and the like, in sequence. (LiP 2,31.6)
Thus ends the thirty-first chapter of the <s>Uttarabhāga</s> of the glorious <s>Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa</s>.
<s>Sanatkumāra</s> said:
Recitation, oblation, worship, gifts, consecration, and the like — as before.
I shall briefly describe the gift of a golden earth. (LiP 2,32.1)
At the previously stated place and time, one should have it made, together with sages,

children.text: lakṣaṇena yathāpūrvaṃ kuṇḍe vā maṇḍale 'tha vā // LiP_2,32.2 //
children.translated_text: with the characteristics as before, in a fire-pit or on a <s>maṇḍala</s>. (LiP 2,32.2)
One should have a divine earth made, with [at least] a thousand [<s>niṣkas</s>] again;
one <s>hasta</s> (cubit) [in size], it should be made square and most beautiful. (LiP 2,32.3)
Furnished with the seven continents and oceans, surrounded by mountains,
equipped with all sacred sites, with <s>Meru</s> in the middle. (LiP 2,32.4)
Or in the middle, one should fashion a continent with nine divisions.
Having made everything as before, on the <s>maṇḍala</s> in the midst of the altar, (LiP 2,32.5)
with a seventh part of [each] seventh part, from a thousand, according to the rule —
the previously mentioned fee should be given to a devotee of <s>Śiva</s>. (LiP 2,32.6)
One should worship <s>Śaṅkara</s> <s>Śiva</s> with a thousand vessels and the like.
The gift of a golden earth is proclaimed as the supreme gift to the <s>liṅga</s>. (LiP 2,32.7)

children.text: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge suvarṇamedinīnīdānaṃ nāma dvātriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
children.translated_text: Thus ends the thirty-second chapter of the <s>Uttarabhāga</s> of the glorious <s>Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa</s>, entitled 'The Gift of a Golden Earth.'
<s>Sanatkumāra</s> said:
Now I shall describe another — the excellent <s>Kalpapādapa</s> (Wish-Fulfilling Tree).
It should be made with a hundred <s>niṣkas</s> [of gold], furnished with all branches. (LiP 2,33.1)
Having made various [decorations] for the branches — pearl garlands and other hangings;
with divine emeralds, one should fashion the tips of the shoots. (LiP 2,33.2)
The learned one should make the sprouts with coral — the sprouts of the tree.
The fruits should be [made] with rubies (<s>padmarāga</s>), adorning all around. (LiP 2,33.3)
The root with sapphire, the trunk excellently with diamond,

children.text: vaiḍūryeṇa drumāgraṃ ca puṣparāgeṇa mastakam // LiP_2,33.4 //
children.translated_text: the treetop with beryl (<s>vaiḍūrya</s>), the crown with topaz (<s>puṣparāga</s>). (LiP 2,33.4)
The bulb with <s>gomedaka</s> (hessonite), with sun-stone, O one of good vows,

children.text: candrakāntena vā vedīṃ drumasya sphaṭikena vā // LiP_2,33.5 //
children.translated_text: the platform of the tree with moon-stone or crystal. (LiP 2,33.5)
The length of the tree is proclaimed as one <s>vitasti</s> (span).

children.text: śākhāṣṭakasya mānaṃ ca vistāraṃ cordhvatastathā // LiP_2,33.6 //
children.translated_text: The measure of the eight branches — both width and height likewise. (LiP 2,33.6)
At its root, one should establish a <s>liṅga</s>, surrounded by the world-guardians.

children.text: pūrvoktavedimadhye tu maṇḍale sthāpya pādapam // LiP_2,33.7 //
children.translated_text: In the midst of the previously described altar, having placed the tree on the <s>maṇḍala</s>, (LiP 2,33.7)
one should worship the god <s>Īśāna</s> and the world-guardians with effort.
Recitation, oblation, and the like, as before, should be performed as in the balance-gift. (LiP 2,33.8)
One should offer the tree to <s>Śambhu</s>, or to the <s>yogins</s>, O King.
or [he is reborn] among the ash-smeared ones — or a king, a sovereign ruler, he shall become. (LiP 2.33.9)
Thus ends the thirty-third chapter, entitled 'The Rite of Feet-Pāda-Dāna,' in the Uttara-bhāga of the glorious <s>Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa</s>.
<s>Sanatkumāra</s> said:
I shall declare the <s>Gaṇeśeśa</s> (Lord of the Gaṇas) gift, in the previously described pavilion.
Having worshipped the God of Gods, the Lord, surrounded by the World-protectors, (LiP 2.34.1)
and the Lords of the Universe according to scripture, endowed with all ornaments,

children.text: daśaniṣkeṇa vai kṛtvā saṃpūjya ca vidhānataḥ // LiP_2,34.2 //
children.translated_text: having made [images] with ten <s>niṣkas</s> of [gold], and having worshipped according to the rite, (LiP 2.34.2)
in the eight <s>dakṣa</s>-[altars] and eight fire-pits, one should perform the fire-offering as before,
by the method of five enclosures, and according to the traditional sequence. (LiP 2.34.3)
Having worshipped seven <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>, and one maiden in the north,
one should have all mantras recited with their respective mantras in sequence. (LiP 2.34.4)

children.text: dattvaivaṃ sarvapāpebhyo mucyate nātra saṃśayaḥ // LiP_2,34.5 //
children.translated_text: Having given thus, one is freed from all sins — there is no doubt in this. (LiP 2.34.5)

children.text: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge gaṇeśeśadānavidinirūpaṇaṃ nāma catustriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
children.translated_text: Thus ends the thirty-fourth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Gaṇeśeśa Gift Rite,' in the Uttara-bhāga of the glorious <s>Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa</s>.
<s>Sanatkumāra</s> said:
Now I shall tell you the procedure for the golden cow (<s>hemadhenū</s>) [gift],
which quells all sins, destroys planetary [afflictions] and famine, (LiP 2.35.1)
quells calamities, and wards off all diseases.

children.text: niṣkāṇāṃ ca sahasreṇa suvarṇena tu kārayet // LiP_2,35.2 //
children.translated_text: One should have [a cow image] made of gold, with a thousand <s>niṣkas</s>; (LiP 2.35.2)

children.text: tadardhenāpi vā samyak tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ /
children.translated_text: or with half of that, or again with half of that half,
or with a hundred — [it should be] endowed with all forms and qualities. (LiP 2.35.3)
In the form of a cow, with beautiful hooves, divine, endowed with all auspicious marks;

children.text: khurāgre vinyasedvajraṃ śṛṅge vai padmarāgakam // LiP_2,35.4 //
children.translated_text: at the tips of the hooves, one should set a diamond; on the horns, a ruby. (LiP 2.35.4)
Between the brows, one should set a divine pearl, O best of sages;

children.text: vauḍūryeṇa stanāḥ kāryā lāṅgūlaṃ nīlataḥ subham // LiP_2,35.5 //
children.translated_text: the udders should be made of <s>vaiḍūrya</s> (cat's eye gem); the tail, auspiciously [set with] sapphire. (LiP 2.35.5)
At the place of teeth, a topaz (<s>puṣparāga</s>) should be made, beautifully;
having fashioned [her] like a real cow, one should make a beautiful calf. (LiP 2.35.6)
Of ten <s>niṣkas</s> of gold, beautifully adorned with all gems.
In the midst of the previously described platform, having prepared a <s>maṇḍala</s>, (LiP 2.35.7)
one should install in its center the [golden] cow (<s>Surabhi</s>) with her calf — [the giver] being a knower of all principles.

children.text: savatsāṃ surabhiṃ tatra vastrayugmena veṣṭayet // LiP_2,35.8 //
children.translated_text: The cow with her calf should be wrapped with a pair of garments. (LiP 2.35.8)
One should worship the cow with the <s>Gāyatrī</s>, with her calf, [as] <s>Surabhi</s>, once again.
Then, by the single-fire rite, one should perform the fire-offering according to the rules. (LiP 2.35.9)
With the procedure of fuel-sticks and ghee-oblations, one should perform the rest as before.

children.text: śivapūjā prakartavyā liṅgaṃ snāpya ghṛtādibhiḥ // LiP_2,35.10 //
children.translated_text: <s>Śiva</s>-worship should be performed, bathing the <s>liṅga</s> with ghee and the like. (LiP 2.35.10)
Having touched the cow with the <s>Gāyatrī</s>, one should give the auspicious [cow] to <s>Śiva</s> [i.e. a Śiva devotee];

children.text: dakṣiṇā ca prakartavyā triṃśanniṣkā mahāmate // LiP_2,35.11 //
children.translated_text: and the <s>dakṣiṇā</s> (sacrificial fee) should be thirty <s>niṣkas</s>, O great wise one. (LiP 2.35.11)

children.text: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge hemadhenudānavidhinīrūpaṇaṃ nāma pañcatriṃśo 'dhyāyaḥ
children.translated_text: Thus ends the thirty-fifth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the Golden Cow Gift Rite,' in the Uttara-bhāga of the glorious <s>Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa</s>.
<s>Sanatkumāra</s> said:
I shall declare the <s>Lakṣmī</s>-gift, which increases great sovereignty.
In the previously described pavilion, on the <s>maṇḍala</s> above the platform, (LiP 2.36.1)
having made an incomparable [image of] <s>Śrī Devī</s> of gold, according to the rite,

children.text: sahasreṇa tadardhena tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ // LiP_2,36.2 //
children.translated_text: with a thousand [niṣkas], or half of that, or again with half of that half, (LiP 2.36.2)
or with one hundred and eight — endowed with all auspicious marks,
one should install <s>Lakṣmī</s> in the <s>maṇḍala</s>, endowed with all ornaments. (LiP 2.36.3)
On her right side, on the sacred ground, one should worship <s>Viṣṇu</s>;
having worshipped the Queen of the Gods according to the rite, with the <s>Śrī Sūkta</s>, (LiP 2.36.4)
one should worship <s>Viṣṇu</s>, <s>Hari</s>, the Guru of the Universe, with the <s>Viṣṇu Gāyatrī</s>.

children.text: ārādhya vidhinā devīṃ pūrvavaddhoma mācaret // LiP_2,36.5 //
children.translated_text: Having propitiated the Goddess according to the rite, one should perform the fire-offering as before. (LiP 2.36.5)
Having offered fuel-sticks according to the rite, one should then perform the ghee-oblation;
one hundred and eight oblations separately — to be offered by the best of <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>. (LiP 2.36.6)

children.text: āhūya yajamānaṃ tu tasyāḥ pūrvadiśi sthale /
children.translated_text: Having summoned the sacrificer, on the eastern side of that [image],
one should show him the Goddess — [he should] prostrate like a staff on the ground. (LiP 2.36.7)
Having bowed to <s>Viṣṇu</s> present there, one should worship <s>Śiva</s> as before.

children.text: tasyā viṃśatibhāgaṃ tu dakṣiṇā parikīrtitā // LiP_2,36.8 //
children.translated_text: One-twentieth of her [value] is declared as the <s>dakṣiṇā</s>. (LiP 2.36.8)
Half of that portion should be given to the others, as appropriate.

children.text: tatastu homayecchaṃbhuṃ bhakto yogī viśeṣataḥ // LiP_2,36.9 //
children.translated_text: Then the devoted yogī should especially offer the fire-oblation to <s>Śambhu</s>. (LiP 2.36.9)

children.text: iti śrīliṅgamahāpurāṇe uttarabhāge lakṣmīdānavidhinirūpaṇaṃ nāma ṣaṭtriṃśattamo 'dhyāyaḥ
children.translated_text: Thus ends the thirty-sixth chapter, entitled 'The Description of the <s>Lakṣmī</s> Gift Rite,' in the Uttara-bhāga of the glorious <s>Liṅga Mahāpurāṇa</s>.
<s>Sanatkumāra</s> said:
Now I shall declare the procedure for the sesame-cow (<s>tiladhenū</s>) [gift].
In the previously described pavilion, one should perform <s>Śiva</s>-worship on the west side. (LiP 2.37.1)
Before it, in the middle of the ground, having drawn a beautiful lotus,
the lotus covered with garments — in its center one should place the auspicious [gift]. (LiP 2.37.2)
Having made a sesame-flower [arrangement], one should deposit a golden lotus;

children.text: triṃśanniṣkema kartavyaṃ tadardhārdhena vā punaḥ // LiP_2,37.3 //
children.translated_text: it should be made with thirty <s>niṣkas</s>, or with half of that half again, (LiP 2.37.3)
or with five <s>niṣkas</s>, or with half of that half again.
Having propitiated that according to the rite, with fragrance, flowers, and the rest in sequence, (LiP 2.37.4)
on the north side of the lotus, one should install eleven <s>Brāhmaṇas</s>.
Having worshipped them according to the rite, with fragrance, flowers, and the rest in sequence, (LiP 2.37.5)
covering garments and upper garments should be given to the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> in order.

children.text: uṣṇīṣaṃ ca pradātavyaṃ kuṇḍaleca vibhūṣite // LiP_2,37.6 //
children.translated_text: A turban should also be given, and ear-rings as adornments. (LiP 2.37.6)
Having given golden rings to the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> according to the rite,

children.text: ekaṃ daśa ca vastrāṇiṃ teṣāmagre prakīrya ca // LiP_2,37.7 //
children.translated_text: [and] one and ten garments, scattering [them] before them, (LiP 2.37.7)
in those garments one should deposit sesame and other [items] separately.
A bronze vessel of a hundred <s>palas</s>, divided into eleven portions; (LiP 2.37.8)
sugarcane stalks should also be given to the <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> especially.

children.text: gośṛge tu hiraṇyena dvinīṣkeṇa tu kārayet // LiP_2,37.9 //
children.translated_text: The cow's horns should be made with gold, with two <s>niṣkas</s> each. (LiP 2.37.9)

children.text: rajatena tu kartavyāḥ khurā niṣkadvayena tu /
children.translated_text: The hooves should be made of silver, with two <s>niṣkas</s>.

children.text: evaṃ pṛthakpṛthag dattvā tattileṣu vinikṣipet // LiP_2,37.10 //
children.translated_text: Having given [all this] separately, one should deposit [it] in those sesame [heaps]. (LiP 2.37.10)
With the eleven <s>Rudra</s>-mantras, one should then give [them] to [Brāhmaṇas representing] the <s>Rudras</s>.
On the east side of the lotus, twelve honored <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> — (LiP 2.37.11)
by this very method, with faith,
with the twelve <s>Āditya</s>-mantras, one should give [to them] in the same way. (LiP 2.37.12)
As before, on the south side, sixteen <s>Brāhmaṇas</s> stationed —
